tools.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
tools.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
schema.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

app_path.description: For 'launch': absolute path (no ~) to the built .app bundle (e.g. /Users/me/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/MyApp-abc123/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app).

device.description: Simulator name (e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro') or UDID. Defaults to the simulator already attached, else the first booted one. The first use of a device asks the user for permission.

udid.description: Alias for 'device' (identical semantics: simulator name or UDID). Pass at most one of 'device' / 'udid'.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

count.description: For 'press_key': how many times to press it, 1 to 20 (default 1).

state.description: For 'set_keyboard': 'show' or 'hide' the on-screen keyboard. For 'set_appearance': 'light' or 'dark'.

Only a report delivered through SubagentHandback reaches your caller; plain text you write at the end of your run is NOT delivered. There is no recipient parameter: the report can only go to your caller.

111	## (d) Problèmes de la candidate
112	
113	D1 à D6 et D8 ont arrêté la formalisation du point concerné : aucune interprétation n'a été choisie. Les définitions concernées portent le suffixe `Base` et ne contiennent que les clauses non ambiguës ; les théorèmes prouvés sur une relation `Base` valent pour toute lecture plus stricte. D7 et D9 sont apparus pendant les preuves ; ils sont traités par des hypothèses ou des auxiliaires nommés, avec contre-exemple ou justification.
114	
115	**D1. « Invariants » parmi les préconditions (C4.6, C5.8, C6.5).** C4.6, sous l'en-tête *Preconditions* : « `AnchorOrderHeld` and the global authority invariants hold in the resulting state ». « Global authority invariants » n'est défini nulle part (Inv3 ? I1–I4 ? WF3 ?). Lu comme précondition, la préservation de ces invariants par `spawn` devient vraie par définition (le théorème 2 serait vide pour eux) ; lu comme obligation (convention de Spec 1 §49 dernier alinéa et §58 : la préservation est une propriété requise des transitions), c'est le théorème 2. Même question pour C5.8 (*Preconditions* du composite : « preserves WF3-corresponding requirements, I1–I4, AnchorOrder, AnchorOrderHeld, NoDangling, and NoOrphan ») et C6.5. Formalisé : `SpawnPreBase` (C4.1–C4.5 et la première moitié de C4.6) ; `exitFrameC` suit le brief (O7 + reparentage), C6.5 est traité comme obligation (théorème 3) ; `SpawnValPreBase` sans C5.8.
116	
117	**D2. État d'évaluation des préconditions non résultantes du composite par valeur (C5.1, C5.4).** C5.4 fixe l'état final pour les conditions « resulting-state » d'O4, mais pas l'état d'évaluation des autres. Deux en dépendent : le droit du côté source d'O4.1 (C5.1) et l'exemption d'O4.4, parce que la partie `spawn` transfère les paramètres à la nouvelle frame. Exemple concret, vérifié par `decide` (`Transfer.readings_differ`) : frame 0 tient une dérivée `Modify` 3 sur la feuille 0 (sa locale), la transmet au contexte créé et transfère la valeur de la place 0 dans une locale fraîche (place 3) du nouveau contexte. Toutes les clauses de `SpawnValPreBase` sont vraies ; le droit source est vrai avant le composite (par l'autorité 3) et faux après la partie `spawn` (3 est tenue par la nouvelle frame et bloque la racine de la place 0, §43 cas 3). Selon la lecture, le composite est donc `ok` ou `reject`. Lecture (a) : le contexte enfant reçoit à la fois la valeur et une autorité `Modify` sur la feuille source devenue `Moved`. Non formalisé : la relation du composite. Même question, sans divergence constatée (non examinée), pour l'état d'évaluation des conditions résultantes de C4.5–C4.6 dans le composite (après la partie `spawn` ou après le composite).
118	
119	**D3. `join` : identifiant inconnu et effet sur `C` (C8).** C8 exige que l'identifiant désigne un contexte connu dont l'état achevé est établi, mais ne donne pas l'issue pour un identifiant inconnu (`reject` ou non habilitée ?) ; il dit que `join` ne modifie pas `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` mais ne dit rien de `C` et `F_C` (un marqueur « joint » est-il prévu ?). Formalisé : seule l'issue `ok` est définie (état inchangé) ; contexte vivant : aucune issue (brief) ; identifiant inconnu : aucune issue, en attente d'arbitrage.
120	
121	**D4. Associations de contrôleur distinctes (C12 contre C13).** C12 : « Different mutex instances must have distinct valid controller associations. » Aucune précondition de C13 ne l'assure (C13.7 porte sur l'identité de `guarded`). Avec le `ControlOf` positionnel, deux autorités `guarded` tenues par le même champ (deux racines de stockage possédées par `data`) ont le même contrôleur. Exemple vérifié (`Traces.shared_controller`) : statiques `m = {data, lock}`, `T₁` et `T₂` possédées par `data` ; `newMutex(1)` puis `newMutex(2)` sont acceptés et `ControlOf` vaut `lock` pour les deux entrées. C13.3 (« valid, non-falsifiable association ») le couvre peut-être, mais n'a pas de contenu formel. `SyncInv` ne contient donc pas la distinction des contrôleurs.
122	
123	**D5. Clauses sans contenu formel.** Non formalisées, faute de définition : C21.4 (« Registry state and the permitted control operations remain coherent ») ; C13.3 pour « non-falsifiable » ; C13.4 (« Shared observations intended for the controller do not conflict structurally with the protected exclusive authority » : `ctl ∉ footprint(guarded)` serait une lecture) ; C13.6 (« declared appropriately for its mutation discipline » : `K.SharedMutable ctl` serait une lecture) ; C17.5 ; C18.3. C21.3 et C21.5 sont formalisés en lecture minimale explicite : contrôleur positionnel existant, feuille utilisable ; unicité de `guarded` parmi les entrées vivantes (C13.7). C18.4 est une obligation.
124	
125	**D6. L'acquisition du contrôleur n'a pas d'effet représentable (C16.1, C17.5).** `S_C` ne porte pas de valeurs (Spec 1 §41 : états d'initialisation seulement) ; l'état « pris/libre » du contrôleur n'existe pas dans `S_C`. Conformément au brief, l'acquisition est représentée par le seul fait d'autorité (`CtrlRight`) et par `grant` dans le registre ; aucun `writeShared` sur le contrôleur n'est effectué par `acquire` ni `unlock`. La correspondance relève d'OB-C05.
126	
127	**D7. `GrantDiscipline` n'est pas inductif seul (C22, C23).** `unlock` (C17) libère le grant `g` et pose `grant = none` ; `GrantDiscipline` n'est rétabli que si tout descendant actif de `guarded` couvrant une feuille protégée est `g` ou un descendant de `g` (O3.3 interdit alors tout descendant actif de `g`). Rien dans WC2 ne l'énonce ; C21.4 (« coherent ») le vise peut-être. Formalisé comme auxiliaire `GrantSubtree`. Second auxiliaire, `RegBound` (toute identité `guarded` enregistrée existe) : sans lui, une entrée morte dont l'identité n'existe pas encore deviendrait vivante à la création d'une autorité fraîche de même identité.
128	
129	**D9. `deriveSync` perd la borne de mode propre (C15).** Le brief et C15 remplacent `ExercisableAt(source, Modify)` de §60.1 par `SyncAuthorized`. Or `ExercisableAt` porte aussi « le mode propre de `source` permet le mode demandé » ; §60.2 ne borne le mode que feuille par feuille et ne dit rien si le footprint est vide. C15 cite pourtant les « mode restrictions » parmi les exigences conservées. Contre-exemple (`Preservation.deriveSync_breaks_i2`) : état atteignable de Spec 1 où frame 0 dérive de la racine de la statique 0 une autorité 3 `Observe` de footprint vide ; avec un `SyncAuthorized` opaque vrai, `deriveSync(3)` crée une dérivée `Modify` d'une autorité `Observe` et viole I2 (§51). Avec l'instanciation de bibliothèque, `SyncInv` (C21.1) donne le mode `Modify` et la préservation tient (`lstep_kInvCA`). À arbitrer : `DeriveSyncPre` doit-il porter la borne, ou est-ce une obligation de `K_C` (C14 : « correct association with a live synchronization entry ») ?
130	
131	**D8. Transposition d'O7.1 (C6, C7).** « The current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller » : C6 parle d'une frame « non-base », mais C3 exige une pile non vide pour tout contexte vivant et C7 traite à part la sortie de la frame initiale d'un contexte. `exitFrameC` est donc défini pour une frame qui a un appelant dans sa propre pile, et `terminate` pour la frame initiale d'un contexte non initial ; C3 et C7 imposent cette lecture, signalée ici parce que C6 ne la formule pas.

137	- Contextes : liste indexée par l'identité ; chaque `Ctx` porte sa pile (sommet en tête), son état de cycle de vie et le parent de sa frame initiale (C3 : un seul par contexte). `stk` d'un contexte non vivant est vide.
138	- `parC` dérivé des piles et des parents de contextes ; `ancestorC` suit `chain parC` ; le bien-fondé est représenté par l'ordre des identités (`FramesC.parent` : le parent précède l'enfant), conformément à Spec 1 §49 dernier alinéa. Sur les états à un contexte, cela ajoute « pile strictement décroissante » à WF3.1 ; tout état atteignable de Spec 1 la vérifie (`reachable_decreasing`, `reachable_single`).
139	- Vues : `SC.view s c` (pile de `c` d'abord, puis les autres frames vivantes) ; Spec 1 §43 ne lit la pile que par son sommet et l'appartenance, et les clauses de §49–§54 seulement par l'appartenance (`wf3_mem_congr` etc.) ; l'ordre des autres frames est donc sans effet sur ces clauses.
140	- `SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, requesting_frame)` reçoit la frame : `SC.viewAt` place cette frame au sommet.
141	- Les opérations de bibliothèque (`newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`) n'ont qu'une issue `ok` (WC2 n'en définit pas d'autre) ; le blocage est une absence d'issue (brief).
142	- Traces : construites directement comme preuves des relations (préconditions décidées par `decide`), sans exécuteur ; un exécuteur sur le patron de `Corpus/Runner.lean` n'était pas nécessaire pour une dizaine de pas.
143	- Invariant inductif du théorème 2 : `KInvC` renforcé par les auxiliaires de Spec 1 (`KAux`, `HeldAnchored`) ; invariant inductif du théorème 4 : `SyncInv ∧ GrantDiscipline` renforcé par `GrantSubtree` et `RegBound`. Les énoncés à partir de l'état initial (`encapsulated_inv`) ne les supposent pas.
144	
145	### Correction faite pendant le travail
146	
147	`NewMutexPreBase.control` exigeait seulement que le `ControlOf` positionnel existe. La preuve du théorème 4 a montré qu'une valeur mutex dont le champ contrôleur n'est pas une feuille passait `newMutex` et violait `SyncInv.control`. C12 dit que `ControlOf` « identifies the synchronization-control leaf » : la clause exige maintenant que le contrôleur soit une feuille (commit ac538af). Ce n'est pas un choix d'interprétation : la version précédente disait moins que C12. `newMutex_nonleaf_rejected` montre l'état concerné : `KInvC` vrai, contrôleur `2` qui n'est pas une feuille, `newMutex` rejeté, et le registre résultant violerait `SyncInv`.
148	
149	### Proposées, non prises (`DESIGN.md` ne les règle pas)
150	
151	- **P1. `K.Satisfiable` dans le modèle concurrent.** `K` reste inchangé (C2) et `Satisfiable` prend un `S3` ; `alloc` exécuté par `c` l'évalue sur `SC.view s c`. Un `K` arbitraire peut distinguer deux linéarisations : à fixer (vue du contexte exécutant, ou `Satisfiable` sur `S_C` avec projection par l'état à un contexte).
152	- **P2. `K_C` instancié par l'état de bibliothèque.** L'instanciation `libKC k L reg` dépend du registre, qui varie le long d'une trace, alors que `K` est un paramètre fixe dans Spec 1. L'obligation de C14 est formalisée par état (`SyncSound kc reg s`). À fixer : `SyncAuthorized` prend-il l'état de bibliothèque en argument ?
153	- **P3. Positions déclarées de `ControlOf`.** `MutexLayout` (position du champ tenant `guarded`, position du contrôleur parmi les enfants ordonnés de la valeur mutex) est un paramètre unique de la bibliothèque (un seul type mutex de référence).
154	- **P4. Garde unifiée de Spec 1 §56 avec l'arène.** `newMutex` consulte le registre de synchronisation et une liste `adm` d'identités d'autres administrations ; `newArena` de `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` ne consulte que le registre des arènes. Dans une bibliothèque combinée, `newArena` devrait consulter le registre de synchronisation (§56). Non fait (module Spec 1 inchangé).
155	- **P5. Style du jalon 4 de `DESIGN.md`.** Non pris : la sémantique reste relationnelle, sans modèle d'événements, et la question de la forme des contrats sous concurrence (DESIGN.md, *Unsafe contracts*) reste ouverte.
156	
157	## (f) Écarts avec la Spec 1
158	
159	- Spec 1 §39 et la formalisation de WF3.1 : le bien-fondé des parents de frames est implicite dans la liste. Avec plusieurs piles et des liens entre contextes, il devient une clause explicite (`FramesC.parent`). Sur les états à un contexte, `ancestorC` coïncide exactement avec §39 (`single_ancestorC`), conformément à C3.
160	- Spec 1 §58 : seules `ok`, `reject` et `fail` existent. L'attente (C8, C16) n'est pas une issue : c'est une transition non habilitée (brief). `Outcome3` n'est pas étendu.
161	- Spec 1 §57, I4 : `Read3Pre` dépend de la frame courante ; I4 ré-indexé est exigé pour chaque contexte (trivial, `i4_always`).
162	- Spec 1 §72.3 : la protection d'origine est évaluée avec le nouveau contexte comme contexte exécutant (C4) ; elle ne dit rien de l'exercice par le créateur, protégé seulement par la restriction de `effective` (§43 cas 3), comme C4 le dit.
163	- Aucune autre divergence trouvée : les seize opérations ré-indexées ont exactement les issues de Spec 1 sur les états à un contexte (théorème 1).
164

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main
2	
3	/-!
4	# Concurrent authority machine: state, frames, invariants
5	
6	Exploratory formalization of the concurrent state `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` of the working
7	candidate `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC2.md` (WC2 C1–C3, C20) on top of the frozen kernel of
8	`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (Spec 1 §38–§45, §49–§57).
9	
10	* contexts with lifecycle states, local stacks and the parent of their initial frame (WC2 C1–C3);
11	* globally live frames, current frame of a context, extended parent relation `parC` and
12	  `ancestorC` (WC2 C3);
13	* the `S3` seen by an executing context (`SC.view`, WC2 C2: current frame = top of its stack,
14	  liveness = globally live frames), the kernel components alone (`SC.flat`), and the projection
15	  `SC.toS3` on single-context states (WC2 C24);
16	* `ConcurrentWF`, `Inv3C`, `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC`, `NoOrphanC` (WC2 C20; Spec 1 §44,
17	  §49–§57 re-indexed);
18	* membership congruence: the kernel invariants of Spec 1 that read the stack only through
19	  membership agree on every view (WC2 C2).
20	-/
21	
22	namespace Ern.Concurrency
23	
24	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
25	
26	/-! ## State (WC2 C1–C3) -/
27	
28	/-- Lifecycle state of an execution context (WC2 C2, C7, C8): live, or completed. -/
29	inductive Life where
30	  | live
31	  | done
32	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
33	
34	/-- Execution context (WC2 C1–C3): its local frame stack, current frame first; its lifecycle
35	state; the parent of its initial frame (`none` for the initial context, whose initial frame is
36	the base frame of Spec 1 §39). -/
37	structure Ctx where
38	  stack : List Nat
39	  life : Life
40	  parent : Option Nat
41	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
42	
43	/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC2 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
44	stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
45	meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
46	structure SC where
47	  C : List Ctx
48	  nF : Nat
49	  P : List Place
50	  I : Nat → InitSt
51	  A : List Authority
52	  D : Nat → List Nat
53	  dead : Nat → Bool
54	  pins : List PinOb
55	
56	/-- Context `c` is live (WC2 C2). -/
57	def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False
58	
59	/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC2 C2). -/
60	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance
61	
62	/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC2 C2, C3). -/
63	def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
64	  match s.C[c]? with
65	  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
66	  | none => []
67	
68	/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC2 C3). -/
69	def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)
70	
71	/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC2 C2). -/
72	def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk
73	
74	/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC2 C2:
75	references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
76	def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
77	  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
78	    pins := s.pins }
79	
80	/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC2 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
81	frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. -/
82	def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
83	  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c) }
84	
85	/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC2 C2). -/
86	def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
87	  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }
88	
89	/-! ## Single-context states (WC2 C24) -/
90	
91	/-- Single-context state (WC2 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
92	parent. -/
93	def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]
94	
95	/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC2 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
96	def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
97	  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
98	    pins := s.pins }
99	
100	/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC2 C24). -/
101	def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
102	  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
103	    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }
104	
105	/-! ## Extended frame-parent relation and ancestry (WC2 C3) -/
106	
107	/-- Parent of frame `f` within a stack whose initial frame has parent `par`: the next frame of
108	the stack, or `par` for the initial frame; `none` if `f` is not in the stack (WC2 C3; Spec 1
109	§39). -/
110	def parIn (par : Option Nat) (f : Nat) : List Nat → Option Nat
111	  | [] => none
112	  | a :: rest => if a = f then rest.head?.or par else parIn par f rest
113	
114	/-- The live context whose stack contains `f` (WC2 C3: frame identities are globally unique). -/
115	def SC.ctxOf (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
116	  (List.range s.C.length).find? fun c => (s.stk c).contains f
117	
118	/-- Extended frame-parent relation `parC` (WC2 C3): the parent of a live frame, following the
119	links across contexts; `none` for the base frame and for frames that are not live. -/
120	def SC.parC (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
121	  (s.ctxOf f).bind fun c => parIn (s.ctxParent c) f (s.stk c)
122	
123	/-- Extended `ancestor_C(f₁, f₂)` (WC2 C3; Spec 1 §39): `f₂` is live and `f₁` is `f₂` or one of
124	its ancestors along `parC`. Chains follow links to smaller identities (Spec 1 §49, last
125	paragraph: identity order represents well-foundedness, required by `FramesC.parent`). -/
126	def SC.ancestorC (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop :=
127	  f₂ ∈ s.frames ∧ (f₁ = f₂ ∨ f₁ ∈ chain s.parC f₂)
128	
129	/-- Decidability of `ancestorC` (WC2 C3). -/
130	instance (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (s.ancestorC f₁ f₂) := by
131	  unfold SC.ancestorC; infer_instance
132	
133	/-! ## Anchor order on the extended ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §54 re-indexed; WC2 C2, C3) -/
134	
135	/-- Spec 1 §44 re-indexed (WC2 C2, C3): the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is
136	`fd` or one of its ancestors along `ancestorC`. -/
137	def EffAnchorOKC (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
138	  OptP (s.A[s.flat.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.flat.hframe z.holder)
139	    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => s.ancestorC g f) False) False) False
140	
141	/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOKC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
142	instance (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOKC s x fd) := by
143	  unfold EffAnchorOKC; infer_instance
144	
145	/-- `AnchorOrder` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC2 C2): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable
146	place `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of `x` is an `ancestorC` of the frame of `q`. -/
147	def AnchorOrderC (s : SC) : Prop :=
148	  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)
149	
150	/-- `AnchorOrderC` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for Spec 1 §44). -/
151	theorem anchorOrderC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderC s ↔
152	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q,
153	      EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q) :=
154	  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩
155	
156	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
157	instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderC s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderC_iff.symm
158	
159	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC2 C2): the rule of `AnchorOrderC` for every
160	active authority held by a usable place `q`. -/
161	def AnchorOrderHeldC (s : SC) : Prop :=
162	  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
163	    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)
164	
165	/-- `AnchorOrderHeldC` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure
166	for Spec 1 §44). -/
167	theorem anchorOrderHeldC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderHeldC s ↔
168	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
169	      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
170	        EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)) True := by
171	  constructor
172	  · intro h q _ hq x _
173	    unfold OptP; split
174	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
175	    · trivial
176	  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
177	    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
178	    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh
179	
180	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeldC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
181	instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeldC s) :=
182	  decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeldC_iff.symm
183	
184	/-! ## Invariants (WC2 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49–§57 re-indexed) -/
185	
186	/-- Frame structure of `S_C` (WC2 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed: "the stack" read as the
187	globally live frames). -/
188	structure FramesC (s : SC) : Prop where
189	  /-- WC2 C3: the initial context, context 0, is live and its initial frame, the base frame of
190	  Spec 1 §39, has no parent. -/
191	  initial : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False
192	  /-- WC2 C3: every live context has a nonempty local stack. -/
193	  nonempty : ∀ c, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []
194	  /-- WC2 C3: frame identities are globally unique; Spec 1 §49.1: duplicate-free. -/
195	  nodup : s.frames.Nodup
196	  /-- Spec 1 §49.1: every frame has a valid identity (below `nF`). -/
197	  bound : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF
198	  /-- WC2 C3: the initial frame of a non-initial live context has a parent (the frame that
199	  created the context, or its reparenting target, WC2 C6). -/
200	  rooted : ∀ c, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none
201	  /-- Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed, WC2 C3: the parent of a live frame is live; the parent precedes
202	  its child, which represents well-foundedness (Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/
203	  parent : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, ∀ g, s.parC f = some g → g ∈ s.frames ∧ g < f
204	
205	/-- `ConcurrentWF` (WC2 C20): the frame structure of `FramesC` and `WF3` (Spec 1 §49.1–§49.8)
206	read with "the stack" as the globally live frames. -/
207	def ConcurrentWF (s : SC) : Prop := FramesC s ∧ WF3 s.flat
208	
209	/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` re-indexed (Spec 1 §50–§53, §57; WC2 C2): `I4` reads `Read3Pre`, which
210	depends on the current frame, so it is required for every executing context. -/
211	def Inv3baseC (s : SC) : Prop :=
212	  I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ ∀ c, I4 (s.view c)
213	
214	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` re-indexed (Spec 1 §57; WC2 C2). -/
215	def Inv3C (s : SC) : Prop := Inv3baseC s ∧ AnchorOrderC s ∧ NoDangling s.flat
216	
217	/-- `NoOrphan` re-indexed (Spec 1 §54; WC2 C2): chains start at a globally live frame. -/
218	def NoOrphanC (s : SC) : Prop := NoOrphan s.flat
219	
220	/-- The kernel invariant of Spec 1 §57 re-indexed (WC2 C20, C23):
221	`ConcurrentWF ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
222	def KInvC (s : SC) : Prop := ConcurrentWF s ∧ Inv3C s ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s ∧ NoOrphanC s
223	
224	/-! ## Views: membership and current frame (WC2 C2) -/
225	
226	/-- Unfolding of `stk` (WC2 C2). -/
227	theorem SC.stk_of {s : SC} {c : Nat} {x : Ctx} (h : s.C[c]? = some x) (hl : x.life = .live) :
228	    s.stk c = x.stack := by simp [SC.stk, h, hl]
229	
230	/-- A context with a nonempty stack is live (WC2 C2). -/
231	theorem SC.live_of_stk {s : SC} {c : Nat} (h : s.stk c ≠ []) : s.Live c := by
232	  unfold SC.stk at h; unfold SC.Live
233	  split at h
234	  · rename_i x hx; rw [hx]; simp only [OptP]; split at h
235	    · assumption
236	    · exact absurd rfl h
237	  · exact absurd rfl h
238	
239	/-- A frame of a stack is globally live (WC2 C2). -/
240	theorem SC.mem_frames_of {s : SC} {c f : Nat} (h : f ∈ s.stk c) : f ∈ s.frames := by
241	  have hc : c < s.C.length := by
242	    unfold SC.stk at h; split at h
243	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
244	    · simp at h
245	  exact List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨c, List.mem_range.2 hc, h⟩
246	
247	/-- Globally live frames are the frames of some stack (WC2 C2). -/
248	theorem SC.mem_frames {s : SC} {f : Nat} : f ∈ s.frames ↔ ∃ c, f ∈ s.stk c := by
249	  constructor
250	  · intro h; obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 h; exact ⟨c, hc⟩
251	  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; exact SC.mem_frames_of hc
252	
253	/-- The view of a context lists exactly the globally live frames (WC2 C2). -/
254	theorem SC.mem_view_F {s : SC} {c f : Nat} : f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.frames := by
255	  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat, List.mem_append, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
256	  constructor
257	  · rintro (h | ⟨h, -⟩)
258	    · exact SC.mem_frames_of h
259	    · exact h
260	  · intro h
261	    by_cases hc : f ∈ s.stk c
262	    · exact .inl hc
263	    · exact .inr ⟨h, hc⟩
264	
265	/-- A block of a duplicate-free concatenation is duplicate-free (WC2 C3). -/
266	theorem nodup_of_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} :
267	    ∀ {l : List α} {a : α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → a ∈ l → (f a).Nodup
268	  | b :: l, a, h, ha => by
269	    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
270	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha
271	    · exact (List.nodup_append.1 h).1
272	    · exact nodup_of_flatMap (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.1 ha
273	
274	/-- Two blocks of a duplicate-free concatenation share no element (WC2 C3: frame identities are
275	globally unique). -/
276	theorem disjoint_of_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} :
277	    ∀ {l : List α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → l.Nodup → ∀ {a a' : α} {x : β}, a ∈ l → a' ∈ l →
278	      x ∈ f a → x ∈ f a' → a = a'
279	  | b :: l, h, hl, a, a', x, ha, ha', hx, hx' => by
280	    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
281	    obtain ⟨-, h₂, h₃⟩ := List.nodup_append.1 h
282	    have hl' := (List.nodup_cons.1 hl).2
283	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with e₁ | h₁ <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha' with e₂ | h₂'
284	    · rw [e₁, e₂]
285	    · subst e₁; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a', h₂', hx'⟩))
286	    · subst e₂; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx' x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a, h₁, hx⟩))
287	    · exact disjoint_of_flatMap h₂ hl' h₁ h₂' hx hx'
288	
289	/-- The stack of a context is duplicate-free when the live frames are (WC2 C3). -/
290	theorem SC.stk_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.stk c).Nodup := by
291	  by_cases hc : c < s.C.length
292	  · exact nodup_of_flatMap hnd (List.mem_range.2 hc)
293	  · simp [SC.stk, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (Nat.le_of_not_lt hc)]
294	
295	/-- The view of a context is duplicate-free when the live frames are (WC2 C3). -/
296	theorem SC.view_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.view c).F.Nodup := by
297	  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat]
298	  refine List.nodup_append.2 ⟨SC.stk_nodup hnd c, hnd.sublist (List.filter_sublist ..),
299	    fun a ha b hb e => ?_⟩
300	  subst e
301	  simp only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at hb
302	  exact hb.2 ha
303	
304	/-- The current frame of the view of `c` is the top of the stack of `c` (WC2 C2). -/
305	theorem SC.view_top {s : SC} {c f : Nat} {rest : List Nat} (h : s.stk c = f :: rest) :
306	    (s.view c).top = f := by
307	  simp [SC.view, S3.top, h]
308	
309	/-! ## Membership congruence (WC2 C2)
310	
311	The clauses of `WF3`, `I1`–`I3`, `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (Spec 1 §49–§54) read the stack only
312	through membership; they agree on states that differ only by the order of the stack. -/
313	
314	section Congr
315	
316	variable {t : S3} {F' : Frames}
317	
318	/-- Usability depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §40). -/
319	theorem usable_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) {q : Nat} :
320	    ({ t with F := F' } : S3).Usable q ↔ t.Usable q :=
321	  ⟨S3.Usable.mono (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).1 h)
322	    (fun _ h => h),
323	   S3.Usable.mono (s' := t) (s := { t with F := F' }) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).2 h)
324	    (fun _ h => h)⟩
325	
326	/-- Holder liveness depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §49.8). -/
327	theorem holderLive_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (h : Holder) :
328	    HolderLive ({ t with F := F' } : S3) h ↔ HolderLive t h := by
329	  cases h with
330	  | frame f => exact hF f
331	  | place p => exact usable_mem_congr hF
332	
333	/-- `WF3` depends on the stack only through membership, duplicate-freedom and nonemptiness
334	(Spec 1 §49). -/
335	theorem wf3_mem_congr (hw : WF3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (hnd : F'.Nodup)
336	    (hne : F' ≠ []) : WF3 { t with F := F' } where
337	  frames := ⟨hne, hnd, fun f hf => hw.frames.2.2 f ((hF f).1 hf)⟩
338	  places := hw.places
339	  owners := ⟨hw.owners.1, hw.owners.2.1, fun q hq => by
340	    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hw.owners.2.2 q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)
341	    exact ⟨f, (FrameOf.congr (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl).2 hf, (hF f).2 hfF⟩⟩
342	  footprints := hw.footprints
343	  origins := hw.origins
344	  rootChain := hw.rootChain
345	  rootHeld := fun r hr hu => hw.rootHeld r hr ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hu)
346	  holders := fun a y hy ya => (holderLive_mem_congr hF _).2 (hw.holders a y hy ya)
347	
348	/-- `I3` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §52). -/
349	theorem i3_mem_congr (h : I3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) : I3 { t with F := F' } :=
350	  fun q hq x hx => h q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq) x hx
351	
352	/-- `NoDangling` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §54). -/
353	theorem noDangling_mem_congr (h : NoDangling t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) :
354	    NoDangling { t with F := F' } :=
355	  fun j y hy ya q hq => h j y hy ya q fun hu => hq ((usable_mem_congr hF).2 hu)
356	
357	end Congr
358	
359	/-- The view of a context is the flat state with a reordered stack (WC2 C2). -/
360	theorem SC.view_eq (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
361	    s.view c = { s.flat with F := (s.view c).F } := rfl
362	
363	/-- `WF3` of the flat state carries to every view (WC2 C2). -/
364	theorem SC.wf3_view {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c : Nat} :
365	    WF3 (s.view c) := by
366	  rw [SC.view_eq]
367	  refine wf3_mem_congr hw (fun f => SC.mem_view_F) (SC.view_nodup hfr.nodup c) ?_
368	  intro he
369	  have h0 := hfr.initial
370	  unfold OptP at h0; split at h0
371	  · rename_i x hx
372	    have hs := hfr.nonempty 0 (by simp [SC.Live, hx, OptP, h0.1])
373	    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hs
374	    have := (SC.mem_view_F (c := c)).2 (SC.mem_frames_of hf)
375	    rw [he] at this; simp at this
376	  · exact h0.elim
377	
378	/-- `WF3` of a view carries to the flat state (WC2 C2). -/
379	theorem SC.wf3_flat_of_view {s : SC} {c : Nat} (hw : WF3 (s.view c)) (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) :
380	    WF3 s.flat := by
381	  have := wf3_mem_congr (t := s.view c) (F' := s.frames) hw
382	    (fun f => SC.mem_view_F.symm) hnd (fun he => by
383	      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hw.frames.1
384	      have := SC.mem_view_F.1 hf; rw [he] at this; simp at this)
385	  exact this
386	
387	end Ern.Concurrency

3	/-!
4	# Concurrent authority machine: inherited operations and frame transitions
5	
6	* the kernel operations O1–O16 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (§60–§75)
7	  executed by a live context `c` (WC2 C2): every operation reads the view of `c` (current frame =
8	  top of its stack, liveness = globally live frames); the clauses that read `ancestor` (§63.6,
9	  §63.7, §64.3, §65.4, §65.5, §72.4, §73.5) read `ancestorC` instead; O6 pushes the new frame on
10	  the stack of `c`; O7 is `exitFrameC` (WC2 C6: O7 and the reparenting of the context-initial
11	  frames whose parent is the exiting frame);
12	* `spawn` (WC2 C4, modeled on Spec 1 §72), `terminate` (WC2 C7, Spec 1 §73 on the initial frame
13	  of a non-initial context), `join` (WC2 C8);
14	* `CStep`, the union of their `ok` transitions.
15	
16	Waiting (`join` on a live context) has no outcome: the transition is not enabled.
17	-/
18	
19	namespace Ern.Concurrency
20	
21	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
22	
23	/-! ## Outcomes (Spec 1 §58) -/
24	
25	/-- Image of an outcome (Spec 1 §58). -/
26	def omap {σ τ : Type} (f : σ → τ) : Outcome3 σ → Outcome3 τ
27	  | .ok s => .ok (f s)
28	  | .reject => .reject
29	  | .fail => .fail
30	
31	/-! ## Operations that do not read `ancestor` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC2 C2) -/
32	
33	/-- An operation of Spec 1 that reads neither `ancestor` nor the stack beyond its top and its
34	membership, run by context `c` on its view and written back (WC2 C2). The context must be live;
35	otherwise the operation has no outcome. -/
36	def ViewStep (R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (c : Nat) (s : SC) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
37	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, R (s.view c) o₃ ∧ o = omap s.set o₃
38	
39	/-! ## O4 `transfer` re-indexed (Spec 1 §63) -/
40	
41	/-- Effect of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect, WC2 C2). -/
42	def transferEffC (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : SC := s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)
43	
44	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed, WC2 C2): the clauses of
45	`TransferPre` on the view of `c`, with §63.6 and §63.7 read on `ancestorC`. -/
46	structure TransferPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : Prop where
47	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
48	  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
49	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
50	  dstUsable : (s.view c).Usable dst
51	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
52	  srcRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify src
53	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
54	  dstRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst
55	  /-- Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
56	  sameShape : SameShape (s.view c).P src dst
57	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
58	  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init
59	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
60	  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init
61	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
62	  disjoint : ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst
63	  /-- Spec 1 §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source,
64	  except some authority grounding the `Modify` right over the source and its origin chain. -/
65	  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
66	    ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
67	      RightChain (s.view c) g j
68	  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
69	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false
70	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
71	  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x
72	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
73	  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst)
74	  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
75	  `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
76	  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
77	    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
78	      OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
79	        y.holder = .place q →
80	          EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
81	            ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True
82	  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
83	  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst
84	  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
85	  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst
86	
87	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63). -/
88	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) :
89	    Decidable (TransferPreC k s c src dst) :=
90	  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable src ∧ (s.view c).Usable dst ∧
91	    HasRight (s.view c) .modify src ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst ∧
92	    SameShape (s.view c).P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init) ∧
93	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst ∧
94	    (∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
95	      ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
96	        RightChain (s.view c) g j) ∧
97	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false) ∧
98	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
99	    AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst) ∧
100	    (∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
101	      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
102	        OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
103	          y.holder = .place q →
104	            EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
105	              ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
106	    NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst ∧ (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst)
107	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
108	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
109	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
110	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩
111	
112	/-! ## O5 `depend` re-indexed (Spec 1 §64) -/
113	
114	/-- Effect of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64 effect, WC2 C2). -/
115	def dependEffC (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : SC := s.set (dependEff (s.view c) q x)

120	  usable : (s.view c).Usable q

135	/-! ## O8 `store` re-indexed (Spec 1 §65) -/
136	
137	/-- Effect of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 effect, WC2 C2). -/
138	def storeEffC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : SC := s.set (storeEff (s.view c) a p)
139	
140	/-- Preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 re-indexed, WC2 C2). -/
141	structure StorePreC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Prop where
142	  /-- Spec 1 §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
143	  derivedHeld : OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
144	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False
145	  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
146	  usable : (s.view c).Usable p

148	  leaf : isLeaf (s.view c).P p

150	  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify p
151	  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
152	  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
153	    OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
154	  /-- Spec 1 §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns. -/
155	  noCover : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
156	    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
157	      l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q
158	  /-- Spec 1 §65.4 re-indexed: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`)

160	  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p)
161	  /-- Spec 1 §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/

166	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65). -/
167	instance (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePreC s c a p) :=
168	  decidable_of_iff (OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
169	      y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False ∧ (s.view c).Usable p ∧ isLeaf (s.view c).P p ∧
170	    HasRight (s.view c) .modify p ∧
171	    (∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
172	      OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
173	    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
174	      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
175	        l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q) ∧
176	    EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p ∧
177	    AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p))
178	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
179	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩
180	
181	/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` re-indexed (Spec 1 §72) -/
182	
183	/-- Effect of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 effect, WC2 C2): the effect of Spec 1 on
184	the view of `c`; the new frame `nF` is pushed on the stack of `c`. -/
185	def enterEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
186	  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
187	    C := s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := s.nF :: x.stack } }
188	
189	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 re-indexed, WC2 C2). -/
190	structure EnterPreC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
191	  /-- Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed: the calling frame, the current frame of `c`, is live. -/
192	  callerLive : s.stk c ≠ []
193	  /-- Spec 1 §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
194	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
195	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
196	  /-- Spec 1 §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
197	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
198	  /-- Spec 1 §72.3 re-indexed: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state, for the
199	  executing context. -/
200	  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p
201	  /-- Spec 1 §72.4 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) over the resulting state. -/
202	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls)
203	
204	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72). -/
205	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
206	    Decidable (EnterPreC s c ps ls) :=
207	  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
208	      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
209	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
210	    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p) ∧
211	    AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls))
212	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
213	
214	/-! ## O7 re-indexed: `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73; WC2 C6) -/
215	
216	/-- Reparenting (WC2 C6.3): every live context whose initial frame has parent `f` gets the
217	parent `p`. -/
218	def reparent (C : List Ctx) (f p : Nat) : List Ctx :=
219	  C.map fun x => if x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = some f then { x with parent := some p } else x
220	
221	/-- Effect of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 effect; WC2 C6): the effect of Spec 1 on
222	the view of `c`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; the top `f` of the stack of `c`
223	is popped, its caller `p` becomes current again, and the context-initial frames whose parent is
224	`f` are reparented to `p` (WC2 C6.3). -/
225	def exitEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
226	  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
227	    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := x.stack.tail })
228	      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) }
229	
230	/-- Preconditions of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 re-indexed; WC2 C6.1: "O7's
231	applicable conditions"). The surviving frames are the other globally live frames. -/
232	structure ExitPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
233	  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed (WC2 C6): the current frame of `c` is not the initial frame of its
234	  context and has a surviving caller in its stack. -/
235	  hasCaller : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []
236	  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
237	  authority among itself and its origins. -/
238	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
239	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
240	  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
241	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
242	    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
243	  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
244	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
245	    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
246	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
247	  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
248	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c)
249	
250	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73). -/
251	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (ExitPreC k s c) :=
252	  decidable_of_iff ((s.stk c).tail ≠ [] ∧
253	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
254	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
255	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
256	      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
257	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
258	      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
259	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
260	    AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c))
261	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
262	
263	/-! ## The inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a context (WC2 C2) -/
264	
265	/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation O1–O16 executed by context `c` (Spec 1 §60–§75
266	re-indexed, WC2 C2). Operations reading `ancestor` or changing the stack have their re-indexed
267	preconditions and effects; the others run on the view of `c`. A context that is not live executes
268	nothing. -/
269	def opStepC (k : K) : KernelOp → Nat → SC → Outcome3 SC → Prop
270	  | .transfer src dst, c, s, o =>
271	    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TransferPreC k s c src dst) (transferEffC s c src dst) o
272	  | .depend q x, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DependPreC s c q x) (dependEffC s c q x) o
273	  | .store a p, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (StorePreC s c a p) (storeEffC s c a p) o
274	  | .enter ps ls, c, s, o =>
275	    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (EnterPreC s c ps ls) (enterEffC s c ps ls) o
276	  | .exit, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (ExitPreC k s c) (exitEffC s c) o
277	  | op, c, s, o => ViewStep (op.Step k) c s o
278	
279	/-! ## `spawn` (WC2 C4, on Spec 1 §72) -/
280	
281	/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC2 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose
282	stack is the fresh frame `nF`, parented to the creating frame; the locals of the new frame and
283	their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
284	view of `c`. -/
285	def spawnEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
286	  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
287	    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }
288	
289	/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC2 C4.1–C4.6), except the second half of
290	WC2 C4.6 ("the global authority invariants hold in the resulting state"), which the candidate does
291	not define (see the report). C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication) hold by
292	construction of `spawnEff`; C4.7 concerns `spawn` with a value (`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`). -/
293	structure SpawnPreBase (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
294	  /-- WC2 C4.1: the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
295	  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
296	  /-- WC2 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
297	  the creating frame. -/
298	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
299	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
300	  /-- WC2 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
301	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
302	  /-- WC2 C4.5, C4 effect (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection evaluated in the resulting state with
303	  the new context as the executing context. -/
304	  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
305	  /-- WC2 C4.6, first half (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting
306	  state. -/
307	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)
308	
309	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC2 C4). -/
310	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
311	    Decidable (SpawnPreBase s c ps ls) :=
312	  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
313	      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
314	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
315	    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
316	    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
317	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
318	
319	/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC2 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
320	def SpawnStep (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
321	  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnPreBase s c ps ls) (spawnEff s c ps ls) o
322	
323	/-! ## `terminate` (WC2 C7, on Spec 1 §73) -/
324	
325	/-- Effect of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC2 C7): the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`
326	for its initial frame `f`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; `c` leaves the
327	live-context set with the completed lifecycle state; the context-initial frames whose parent is
328	`f` are reparented to the parent of `f` (WC2 C6.3). -/
329	def termEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
330	  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
331	    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := [], life := .done })
332	      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) }
333	
334	/-- Preconditions of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC2 C7: the O7 validity requirements applied to
335	the initial frame of a terminating non-initial context, after its nested call frames have
336	ended). -/
337	structure TermPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
338	  /-- WC2 C7: a non-initial context (WC2 C3: the base frame never exits). -/
339	  nonInitial : c ≠ 0
340	  /-- WC2 C7: the nested call frames have ended; only the initial frame remains. -/
341	  initialOnly : (s.stk c).length = 1
342	  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed: the initial frame has a surviving parent. -/
343	  hasParent : OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False
344	  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
345	  authority among itself and its origins. -/
346	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
347	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
348	  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
349	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
350	    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
351	  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
352	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
353	    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
354	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
355	  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
356	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c)
357	
358	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `terminate` (WC2 C7). -/
359	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (TermPre k s c) :=
360	  decidable_of_iff (c ≠ 0 ∧ (s.stk c).length = 1 ∧
361	    OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False ∧
362	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
363	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
364	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
365	      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
366	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
367	      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
368	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
369	    AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c))
370	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
371	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩
372	
373	/-- `terminate` executed by `c` (WC2 C7): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
374	def TermStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
375	  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TermPre k s c) (termEffC s c) o
376	
377	/-! ## `join` (WC2 C8) -/
378	
379	/-- `join d` executed by `c` (WC2 C8): `ok` with the state unchanged when `d` designates a known
380	context whose completed state is established. A live target has no outcome (waiting is a
381	non-enabled transition). WC2 C8 states no outcome for an unknown identifier and no effect on `C`
382	or `F_C`; the relation gives none (see the report). -/
383	inductive JoinStep (s : SC) (c d : Nat) : Outcome3 SC → Prop where
384	  | ok : s.Live c → OptP (s.C[d]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False → JoinStep s c d (.ok s)
385	
386	/-! ## Concurrent kernel steps -/
387	
388	/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel without synchronization (WC2 C2, C4, C6–C8):
389	an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by a context, `spawn`, `terminate` or `join`. -/
390	inductive CStep (k : K) : SC → SC → Prop where
391	  | kernel {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} : opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
392	  | spawn {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
393	      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
394	  | terminate {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} : TermStep k s c (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
395	  | join {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} : JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
396	
397	end Ern.Concurrency

3	/-!
4	# Concurrent contract `K_C` and the kernel transition `deriveSync`
5	
6	* `KC` (WC2 C2, C14): the Spec 1 contract `K` (§48, §80), reached by the projection `KC.toK`,
7	  extended with the opaque predicate `SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, requesting_frame)`;
8	* `deriveSync` (WC2 C15): O1 (Spec 1 §60) on `source = guarded`, `region = footprint(guarded)`,
9	  `mode = Modify`, executed by a live context, with the conjunct `ExercisableAt(source, mode)` of
10	  §60.1 replaced by `K_C.SyncAuthorized`; the other conjuncts of §60.1 and §60.2–§60.4 are kept;
11	* `CStepS`, the concurrent kernel steps with `deriveSync`.
12	-/
13	
14	namespace Ern.Concurrency
15	
16	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
17	
18	/-- External contract `K_C` (WC2 C2, C14): the unchanged Spec 1 contract `K` (§48), its
19	projection being `KC.toK`, and the opaque predicate `SyncAuthorized(state, guarded,
20	requesting_frame)` of WC2 C14. Obligations of `K_C` are hypotheses of theorems, never fields. -/
21	structure KC extends K where
22	  SyncAuthorized : SC → Nat → Nat → Prop
23	
24	/-- Effect of `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C15): a fresh active authority of mode
25	`Modify`, origin `guarded`, footprint `footprint(guarded)`, held by the current frame of `c`;
26	this is the `ok` effect of O1 (Spec 1 §60) on the view of `c`. -/
27	def deriveSyncEff (s : SC) (c g : Nat) : SC :=
28	  s.set (deriveEff (s.view c) g ((s.view c).afp g) .modify)
29	
30	/-- Preconditions of `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C15): those of O1 (Spec 1 §60)
31	for `source = guarded`, `region = footprint(guarded)`, `mode = Modify`, on the view of `c`, with
32	`ExercisableAt(source, Modify)` replaced by `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, current frame)`. -/
33	structure DeriveSyncPre (kc : KC) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) : Prop where
34	  /-- Spec 1 §60.1: `source` is active. -/
35	  active : (s.view c).Active g
36	  /-- WC2 C15, replacing `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)` of Spec 1 §60.1. -/
37	  authorized : kc.SyncAuthorized s g (s.view c).top
38	  /-- Spec 1 §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source` is active. -/
39	  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ (s.view c).ancs g, (s.view c).Active x
40	  /-- Spec 1 §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
41	  leaves : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
42	  /-- Spec 1 §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
43	  within : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ (s.view c).afp g
44	  /-- Spec 1 §60.2: `Modify` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
45	  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, Allows (effective (s.view c) g l) .modify
46	  /-- Spec 1 §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50). -/
47	  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
48	    b ∉ g :: (s.view c).ancs g → (∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ y.footprint) →
49	      y.mode = .observe ∧ Mode.modify = .observe) True
50	  /-- Spec 1 §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
51	  frameLive : (s.view c).top ∈ (s.view c).F
52	
53	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `deriveSync` (WC2 C15). -/
54	instance (kc : KC) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) [Decidable (kc.SyncAuthorized s g (s.view c).top)] :
55	    Decidable (DeriveSyncPre kc s c g) :=
56	  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Active g ∧ kc.SyncAuthorized s g (s.view c).top ∧
57	    (∀ x ∈ (s.view c).ancs g, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
58	    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧
59	    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ (s.view c).afp g) ∧
60	    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, Allows (effective (s.view c) g l) .modify) ∧
61	    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
62	      b ∉ g :: (s.view c).ancs g → (∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ y.footprint) →
63	        y.mode = .observe ∧ Mode.modify = .observe) True) ∧
64	    (s.view c).top ∈ (s.view c).F)
65	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
66	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩
67	
68	/-- `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C15): `ok` or `reject` (Spec 1 §58 for kernel
69	transitions); no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
70	def DeriveSyncStep (kc : KC) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
71	  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DeriveSyncPre kc s c g) (deriveSyncEff s c g) o
72	
73	/-- WC2 C15: the authority created by `deriveSync` is an ordinary authority of mode `Modify`,
74	origin `guarded`, footprint `footprint(guarded)`, held by the current frame, active, of fresh
75	identity `|A|`. -/
76	theorem deriveSync_created {kc : KC} {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat}
77	    (h : DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s')) :
78	    s'.A = s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some g, (s.view c).afp g, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := by
79	  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h
80	  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
81	  rfl
82	
83	/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel (WC2 C2, C4, C6–C8, C15): a step of `CStep`
84	under the projection `K_C.toK`, or `deriveSync`. -/
85	inductive CStepS (kc : KC) : SC → SC → Prop where
86	  | base {s s' : SC} : CStep kc.toK s s' → CStepS kc s s'
87	  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat} : DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s') → CStepS kc s s'
88	
89	end Ern.Concurrency
