3	/-!
4	# Reference synchronization library
5	
6	Library state separate from `S_C` (WC2 C2, C12), on the pattern of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (Spec
7	1 §46, §55, §56):
8	
9	* the registry of `SyncEntry { guarded, grant }` (WC2 C12), liveness of an entry, the positional
10	  `ControlOf` relationship (WC2 C12) for declared field positions `MutexLayout`;
11	* `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3 and 5) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22);
12	* the library instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized`, limited to registry and controller facts, and
13	  the contract obligation `SyncSound` of WC2 C14 ("unavailable outside the corresponding valid
14	  synchronization contract");
15	* derived operations `newMutex` (C13), `acquire` (C16), `unlock` (C17), `resetLock` (C18);
16	* labelled library steps, runs, and the encapsulation hypothesis `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC2 C22,
17	  C23, C25), a predicate on runs, never a precondition of a kernel operation.
18	-/
19	
20	namespace Ern.Concurrency
21	
22	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
23	
24	/-! ## Registry (WC2 C12) -/
25	
26	/-- Synchronization entry (WC2 C12): the protected authority `guarded` and the recorded grant. -/
27	structure SyncEntry where
28	  guarded : Nat
29	  grant : Option Nat
30	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
31	
32	/-- Synchronization registry (WC2 C12), library state separate from `S_C`. -/
33	abbrev SyncReg := List SyncEntry
34	
35	/-- Declared field positions of the reference mutex value (WC2 C12, "its declared field
36	positions"): the position of the field holding `guarded` and that of the controller, among the
37	ordered children of the mutex value. -/
38	structure MutexLayout where
39	  guardedField : Nat
40	  controlField : Nat
41	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
42	
43	/-- An entry is live exactly while `guarded` is active (WC2 C12). -/
44	def SyncEntry.Live (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop := s.flat.Active e.guarded
45	
46	/-- Decidability of liveness of an entry (WC2 C12). -/
47	instance (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Decidable (e.Live s) := by
48	  unfold SyncEntry.Live; infer_instance
49	
50	/-- Positional `ControlOf` (WC2 C12): `guarded` is held by the field `h` at position
51	`guardedField` of the mutex value `m` (the structural parent of `h`); the controller is the child
52	of `m` at position `controlField`. -/
53	def ControlOf (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Option Nat :=
54	  match (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) with
55	  | some (Holder.place h) =>
56	    match parentOf s.P h with
57	    | some m =>
58	      if (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some h then (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? else none
59	    | none => none
60	  | _ => none
61	
62	/-- The `S3` whose current frame is `f` (WC2 C14: `SyncAuthorized` names the requesting frame;
63	Spec 1 §43 reads the stack only through its top and membership). -/
64	def SC.viewAt (s : SC) (f : Nat) : S3 :=
65	  { s.flat with F := f :: s.frames.filter fun g => decide (g ≠ f) }
66	
67	/-- Controller fact (brief, instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`): the frame `f` has an effective
68	mode on `ControlOf(e)`: some authority exercisable by `f` in a mode at least `Observe` has a
69	present effective mode on the controller (the authority condition of Spec 1 §68.2). -/
70	def CtrlRight (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
71	  OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length,
72	    (s.viewAt f).ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ effective s.flat a ctl ≠ none) False
73	
74	/-- Decidability of the controller fact. -/
75	instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (CtrlRight L s e f) := by
76	  unfold CtrlRight; infer_instance
77	
78	/-- Library authorization for an entry (brief: registry and controller facts only): the entry is
79	live, its grant is available (`grant = none`), and the requesting frame has an effective mode on
80	its controller. -/
81	def EntryAuth (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
82	  e.Live s ∧ e.grant = none ∧ CtrlRight L s e f
83	
84	/-- Decidability of the library authorization of an entry. -/
85	instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (EntryAuth L s e f) := by
86	  unfold EntryAuth; infer_instance
87	
88	/-- Instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, requesting_frame)` by the library (WC2
89	C14, C25; brief: registry and controller facts only): an entry of the registry for `guarded`
90	authorizes the requesting frame. -/
91	def LibSyncAuthorized (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) : Prop :=
92	  ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ EntryAuth L s e f
93	
94	/-- Decidability of the library instantiation. -/
95	instance (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
96	    Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f) := by
97	  unfold LibSyncAuthorized; infer_instance
98	
99	/-- The contract `K_C` instantiated by the library on the registry `reg` (WC2 C14, C25). -/
100	def libKC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) : KC :=
101	  { k with SyncAuthorized := LibSyncAuthorized L reg }
102	
103	/-- Decidability of the instantiated predicate. -/
104	instance (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
105	    Decidable ((libKC k L reg).SyncAuthorized s g f) :=
106	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f))
107	
108	/-- Contract obligation of WC2 C14 ("unavailable outside the corresponding valid synchronization
109	contract"), in state `s` with registry `reg`: `SyncAuthorized` holds only for the `guarded` of a
110	live entry. -/
111	def SyncSound (kc : KC) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) : Prop :=
112	  ∀ g f, kc.SyncAuthorized s g f → ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ e.Live s
113	
114	/-- The library instantiation satisfies the obligation of WC2 C14. -/
115	theorem libKC_sound (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) :
116	    SyncSound (libKC k L reg) reg s :=
117	  fun _ _ ⟨e, he, hg, hl, _⟩ => ⟨e, he, hg, hl⟩
118	
119	/-- The holder is a usable place (WC2 C12, C21.1). -/
120	def PlaceUsable (t : S3) : Holder → Prop
121	  | .place q => t.Usable q
122	  | .frame _ => False
123	
124	/-- Decidability of `PlaceUsable` (WC2 C12). -/
125	instance (t : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (PlaceUsable t h) := by
126	  cases h <;> unfold PlaceUsable <;> infer_instance
127	
128	/-- Spec 1 §65.3 for an authority held by a place `q`: it covers neither a leaf of `q` nor a leaf
129	of storage transitively owned by `q` (WC2 C13.5). -/
130	def StoredOK (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
131	  match y.holder with
132	  | .place q => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∉ footprint P q ∧
133	      ∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, OwnedIn P q r → l ∉ footprint P r
134	  | .frame _ => True
135	
136	/-- Decidability of `StoredOK` (Spec 1 §65.3). -/
137	instance (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Decidable (StoredOK P y) := by
138	  unfold StoredOK; split <;> infer_instance
139	
140	/-! ## Invariants (WC2 C21, C22) -/
141	
142	/-- Active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf, a leaf of `footprint(guarded)`
143	(WC2 C18.2, C22). -/
144	def CoveringDesc (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Prop :=
145	  g ∈ s.flat.ancs j ∧ s.flat.Active j ∧ ∃ l ∈ s.flat.afp j, l ∈ s.flat.afp g
146	
147	/-- Decidability of `CoveringDesc` (WC2 C22). -/
148	instance (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (CoveringDesc s g j) := by
149	  unfold CoveringDesc; infer_instance
150	
151	/-- No active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf (WC2 C18.2, C22). -/
152	def NoCoveringDesc (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Prop := ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ CoveringDesc s g j
153	
154	/-- Decidability of `NoCoveringDesc` (WC2 C22). -/
155	instance (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Decidable (NoCoveringDesc s g) := by
156	  unfold NoCoveringDesc; infer_instance
157	
158	/-- `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22): for every live entry with `grant = none`, no active descendant of
159	`guarded` covers a protected leaf. -/
160	def GrantDiscipline (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
161	  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
162	
163	/-- `SyncInv` (WC2 C21), items 1, 2, 3 and 5. Item 4 ("Registry state and the permitted control
164	operations remain coherent") has no formal content in WC2 and is not formalized (see the
165	report). -/
166	structure SyncInv (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop where
167	  /-- WC2 C21.1: `guarded` is active (liveness), has own mode `Modify`, and is held by a usable
168	  place. -/
169	  guarded : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
170	    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
171	  /-- WC2 C21.2: a recorded grant has origin `guarded` and footprint `footprint(guarded)`. -/
172	  grant : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
173	    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
174	  /-- WC2 C21.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC2 C12: the controller exists and is a usable
175	  leaf. -/
176	  control : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
177	    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
178	  /-- WC2 C21.5 (identity uniqueness among live entries, WC2 C13.7). -/
179	  unique : ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
180	    e.Live s → e'.Live s →
181	    e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
182	
183	/-! ## Derived operations (WC2 C13, C16–C18) -/
184	
185	/-- Preconditions of `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C13), with `adm` the identities used
186	by the other live administrations (Spec 1 §56). Items C13.3 ("non-falsifiable"), C13.4 and C13.6
187	are not formalized (see the report). -/
188	structure NewMutexPreBase (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg)
189	    (c g : Nat) : Prop where
190	  /-- WC2 C13.1: `guarded` is active, of own mode `Modify`, and held by a usable place. -/
191	  guarded : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
192	    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
193	  /-- WC2 C13.2: ordinary exercisable `Modify` over `guarded`. -/
194	  exercisable : (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify
195	  /-- WC2 C13.3 with WC2 C12: the positional `ControlOf` designates a controller, and it is a leaf
196	(WC2 C12: `ControlOf` "identifies the synchronization-control leaf"). -/
197	  control : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => isLeaf s.P ctl) False
198	  /-- WC2 C13.5: when `guarded` is stored (derived), Spec 1 §65.3 holds: it covers neither a leaf
199	  of its holder nor a leaf of storage transitively owned by it. -/
200	  stored : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False
201	  /-- WC2 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live entry. -/
202	  unique : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g
203	  /-- WC2 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live administration. -/
204	  otherAdmin : g ∉ adm
205	  /-- WC2 C13.8: `GrantDiscipline` is established for the new entry. -/
206	  available : NoCoveringDesc s g
207	
208	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `newMutex` (WC2 C13). -/
209	instance (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat) :
210	    Decidable (NewMutexPreBase L adm s reg c g) :=
211	  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
212	      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False ∧
213	    (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify ∧
214	    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
215	    OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False ∧
216	    (∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g) ∧ g ∉ adm ∧ NoCoveringDesc s g)
217	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h⟩,
218	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h⟩⟩
219	
220	/-- `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C13): registers the entry `⟨guarded, none⟩`; the
221	kernel state is unchanged and no authority is created. WC2 C13 states no outcome other than
222	success; only `ok` is defined. -/
223	def NewMutexOk (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat)
224	    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
225	  s.Live c ∧ NewMutexPreBase L adm s reg c g ∧ st' = (s, reg ++ [⟨g, none⟩])
226	
227	/-- `acquire` on entry `i` executed by `c` (WC2 C16): with the library instantiation of
228	`SyncAuthorized` for the entry, `deriveSync(guarded)` and the record of the fresh grant identity
229	`|A|` in the entry. A taken controller (`grant ≠ none`) leaves `acquire` not enabled; WC2 C16
230	states no other outcome than success, so only `ok` is defined. -/
231	def AcquireOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat)
232	    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
233	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ EntryAuth L s e (s.view c).top ∧
234	    DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L reg) s c e.guarded ∧
235	    st' = (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded, reg.set i { e with grant := some s.A.length })
236	
237	/-- `unlock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC2 C17): items 1–4 (item 4 read as the controller
238	fact of the library instantiation); O3 releases the grant and the registry records
239	`grant = none`. Item 5 ("a permitted controller update under its declared shared-mutation
240	discipline") is not formalized (see the report); only `ok` is defined. -/
241	def UnlockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
242	    Prop :=
243	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e g, reg[i]? = some e ∧ e.Live s ∧ e.grant = some g ∧ ReleasePre (s.view c) g ∧
244	    CtrlRight L s e (s.view c).top ∧
245	    st' = (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g), reg.set i { e with grant := none })
246	
247	/-- `resetLock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC2 C18): items 1 and 2; the entry becomes
248	available; the kernel state is unchanged. Item 3 ("a valid, exclusive recovery contract") is not
249	formalized and item 4 is an obligation (see the report); only `ok` is defined. -/
250	def ResetLockOk (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
251	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ (s.view c).ExercisableAt e.guarded .modify ∧
252	    NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded ∧ st' = (s, reg.set i { e with grant := none })
253	
254	/-! ## Labelled steps, runs, encapsulation (WC2 C22, C23, C25) -/
255	
256	/-- Label of a step of the kernel with the synchronization library. -/
257	inductive Label where
258	  | kernel (c : Nat) (op : KernelOp)
259	  | spawn (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
260	  | terminate (c : Nat)
261	  | join (c d : Nat)
262	  | deriveSync (c g : Nat)
263	  | newMutex (c g : Nat) (adm : List Nat)
264	  | acquire (c i : Nat)
265	  | unlock (c i : Nat)
266	  | resetLock (c i : Nat)
267	
268	/-- Labelled `ok` step of the concurrent kernel with the synchronization library (WC2 C2, C4,
269	C6–C8, C13, C15–C18): kernel and frame steps keep the registry; raw `deriveSync` runs under the
270	library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`. -/
271	inductive LStep (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Label → SC × SyncReg → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
272	  | kernel {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} :
273	      opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → LStep k L (.kernel c op) (s, reg) (s', reg)
274	  | spawn {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
275	      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawn c ps ls) (s, reg) (s', reg)
276	  | terminate {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} :
277	      TermStep k s c (.ok s') → LStep k L (.terminate c) (s, reg) (s', reg)
278	  | join {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c d : Nat} :
279	      JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → LStep k L (.join c d) (s, reg) (s', reg)
280	  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} :
281	      DeriveSyncStep (libKC k L reg) s c g (.ok s') → LStep k L (.deriveSync c g) (s, reg) (s', reg)
282	  | newMutex {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} {adm : List Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
283	      NewMutexOk L adm s reg c g st' → LStep k L (.newMutex c g adm) (s, reg) st'
284	  | acquire {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
285	      AcquireOk k L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.acquire c i) (s, reg) st'
286	  | unlock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
287	      UnlockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.unlock c i) (s, reg) st'
288	  | resetLock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
289	      ResetLockOk s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.resetLock c i) (s, reg) st'
290	
291	/-- Encapsulation of one step in state `st` (hypothesis on traces, WC2 C22, C23, C25: the
292	abstraction exposes no safe path compromising its invariant): no inherited `derive` or `split`
293	from, and no raw `deriveSync` of, the `guarded` of a live entry (only `acquire` derives from it);
294	no `transfer` whose source is the place holding the `guarded` of a live entry (the mutex value
295	moves as a whole). -/
296	def Encap (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
297	  | .kernel _ (.derive src _ _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
298	  | .kernel _ (.split src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
299	  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 →
300	      (st.1.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) ≠ some (.place src)
301	  | .deriveSync _ g => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → g ≠ e.guarded
302	  | _ => True
303	
304	/-- Runs of labelled steps. -/
305	inductive LRun (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
306	  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : LRun k L st [] st
307	  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
308	      LStep k L lbl st st₁ → LRun k L st₁ lbls st₂ → LRun k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂
309	
310	/-- `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC2 C22, C23: "preservation of library invariants may be conditional on
311	correct encapsulation, but that condition must be stated"): a run every step of which satisfies
312	`Encap` in the state where it is taken. -/
313	inductive EncapsulatedTrace (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
314	    SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
315	  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : EncapsulatedTrace k L st [] st
316	  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
317	      Encap st lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ → EncapsulatedTrace k L st₁ lbls st₂ →
318	      EncapsulatedTrace k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂
319	
320	/-- An encapsulated trace is a run. -/
321	theorem EncapsulatedTrace.run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
322	    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') : LRun k L st lbls st' := by
323	  induction h with
324	  | nil => exact .nil
325	  | cons _ hs _ ih => exact .cons hs ih
326	
327	/-! ## Theorem 1, last part: `SyncAuthorized` and `deriveSync` without live entry (WC2 C14, C24) -/
328	
329	/-- Theorem 1 (WC2 C14, C24): in a state whose registry has no live entry, the obligation of WC2
330	C14 makes `K_C.SyncAuthorized` false. Fragment: every state, single-context ones included. -/
331	theorem syncAuthorized_false {kc : KC} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC} (hsound : SyncSound kc reg s)
332	    (hnone : ∀ e ∈ reg, ¬ e.Live s) (g f : Nat) : ¬ kc.SyncAuthorized s g f := fun h => by
333	  obtain ⟨e, he, -, hl⟩ := hsound g f h
334	  exact hnone e he hl
335	
336	/-- Theorem 1 (WC2 C15, C24): in a state whose registry has no live entry, under the obligation
337	of WC2 C14, `deriveSync` is never enabled. -/
338	theorem conservative_deriveSync {kc : KC} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC} (hsound : SyncSound kc reg s)
339	    (hnone : ∀ e ∈ reg, ¬ e.Live s) (c g : Nat) (s' : SC) : ¬ DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s') :=
340	  fun ⟨_, h⟩ => syncAuthorized_false hsound hnone g _ (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.authorized
341	
342	/-! ## Theorem 6: exclusivity of grants (Spec 1 §50; WC2 C15) -/
343	
344	/-- An ancestor of an authority whose origin is `g` is `g` or below `g` (Spec 1 §42, §49.5). -/
345	theorem ancs_le_origin {t : S3} (hw : WF3 t) {b g : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : t.A[b]? = some y)
346	    (hyo : y.origin = some g) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ t.ancs b) : x ≤ g := by
347	  have hgb : g < b := hw.origins b y g hy hyo
348	  have horg : t.org b = some g := by simp [S3.org, hy, hyo]
349	  rw [S3.ancs, chain_cons horg hgb] at hx
350	  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
351	  · exact Nat.le_refl _
352	  · exact Nat.le_of_lt (chain_lt hx)
353	
354	/-- Theorem 6 (Spec 1 §50, I1; WC2 C15, C21.2): two distinct active authorities of own mode
355	`Modify` whose origin is the same `guarded` and whose footprint is `footprint(guarded)`, nonempty,
356	cannot coexist. Fragment: states satisfying `WF3` and `I1` on the globally live frames. -/
357	theorem grants_exclusive {s : SC} (hw : WF3 s.flat) (h1 : I1 s.flat) {g a b : Nat}
358	    {x y : Authority} (hab : a ≠ b) (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) (hy : s.A[b]? = some y)
359	    (xa : x.active = true) (ya : y.active = true) (xm : x.mode = .modify)
360	    (xo : x.origin = some g) (yo : y.origin = some g)
361	    (xf : ∀ l, l ∈ x.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp g) (yf : ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp g)
362	    {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ s.flat.afp g) : False := by
363	  have hga : g < a := hw.origins a x g hx xo
364	  have hgb : g < b := hw.origins b y g hy yo
365	  have hna : a ∉ s.flat.ancs b := fun h => by have := ancs_le_origin hw hy yo h; omega
366	  have hnb : b ∉ s.flat.ancs a := fun h => by have := ancs_le_origin hw hx xo h; omega
367	  have := h1 a b x y l hab hx hy xa ya ((xf l).2 hl) ((yf l).2 hl) hna hnb
368	  rw [xm] at this; cases this.1
369	
370	/-! ## Theorem 5: realizability (WC2 C25) -/
371	
372	/-- Theorem 5 (WC2 C14, C15, C25): under `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline`, and the kernel invariant
373	re-indexed (`KInvC`: `WF3`, `I1` and `I2` are used), the library instantiation of
374	`SyncAuthorized` (registry and controller facts only) for the current frame of a live context
375	entails that no active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf and all the preconditions
376	of `deriveSync`, in particular I1 for the full-footprint grant (§60.3) and the validity of the
377	origin chain (§60.1). Fragment: states satisfying `KInvC`. -/
378	theorem realizability {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC} {c g : Nat}
379	    (hk : KInvC s) (hsi : SyncInv L s reg) (hgd : GrantDiscipline s reg) (hc : s.stk c ≠ [])
380	    (ha : LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g (s.view c).top) :
381	    NoCoveringDesc s g ∧ DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L reg) s c g := by
382	  obtain ⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩, -, -⟩, -, -⟩ := hk
383	  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl, hl, hn, hcr⟩ := ha
384	  have hnc := hgd e he hl hn
385	  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hl
386	  have hy' : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
387	  have hym : y.mode = .modify := by
388	    have := hsi.guarded e he ⟨y, hy, ya⟩; simp only [OptP, hy'] at this; exact this.1
389	  have hfp : s.flat.afp e.guarded = y.footprint := by simp [S3.afp, hy]
390	  have hafp : ∀ {j : Nat} {z : Authority}, s.A[j]? = some z → s.flat.afp j = z.footprint :=
391	    fun hz => by simp [S3.afp, SC.flat, hz]
392	  refine ⟨hnc, ⟨y, hy, ya⟩, ⟨e, he, rfl, ⟨y, hy, ya⟩, hn, hcr⟩, ?_, ?_, fun l h => h, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
393	  · exact I2.ancs_active h2 ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
394	  · intro l hl'
395	    have hl'' : l ∈ y.footprint := by rw [← hfp]; exact hl'
396	    exact hw.footprints _ y hy l hl''
397	  · intro l hl'
398	    have hl'' : l ∈ y.footprint := by rw [← hfp]; exact hl'
399	    have hd : descModes s.flat e.guarded l = [] := by
400	      apply nil_of_forall_not_mem
401	      intro m hm
402	      obtain ⟨j, z, hz, za, hlz, hanc, -⟩ := mem_descModes.1 hm
403	      exact hnc j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
404	        ⟨hanc, ⟨z, hz, za⟩, l, by rw [hafp hz]; exact hlz, hl'⟩
405	    change Allows (effective s.flat e.guarded l) .modify
406	    rw [effective_eq hy ya hl'', hd, hym]
407	    simp [effOf, Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
408	  · intro b _
409	    unfold OptP; split
410	    · rename_i z hz
411	      intro za hnb hcov
412	      exfalso
413	      obtain ⟨l, hl', hlz⟩ := hcov
414	      have hb : b ≠ e.guarded := fun h => hnb (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
415	      have hnanc : b ∉ s.flat.ancs e.guarded := fun h => hnb (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
416	      by_cases hdesc : e.guarded ∈ s.flat.ancs b
417	      · exact hnc b (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz)) ⟨hdesc, ⟨z, hz, za⟩, l,
418	          by rw [hafp hz]; exact hlz, hl'⟩
419	      · have hl'' : l ∈ y.footprint := by rw [← hfp]; exact hl'
420	        have := h1 e.guarded b y z l (Ne.symm hb) hy hz ya za hl'' hlz hdesc hnanc
421	        rw [hym] at this; cases this.1
422	    · trivial
423	  · obtain ⟨f, rest, hf⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hc
424	    simp [SC.view, S3.top, hf]
425	
426	end Ern.Concurrency

3	/-!
4	# Concurrent contract `K_C` and the kernel transition `deriveSync`
5	
6	* `KC` (WC2 C2, C14): the Spec 1 contract `K` (§48, §80), reached by the projection `KC.toK`,
7	  extended with the opaque predicate `SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, requesting_frame)`;
8	* `deriveSync` (WC2 C15): O1 (Spec 1 §60) on `source = guarded`, `region = footprint(guarded)`,
9	  `mode = Modify`, executed by a live context, with the conjunct `ExercisableAt(source, mode)` of
10	  §60.1 replaced by `K_C.SyncAuthorized`; the other conjuncts of §60.1 and §60.2–§60.4 are kept;
11	* `CStepS`, the concurrent kernel steps with `deriveSync`.
12	-/
13	
14	namespace Ern.Concurrency
15	
16	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
17	
18	/-- External contract `K_C` (WC2 C2, C14): the unchanged Spec 1 contract `K` (§48), its
19	projection being `KC.toK`, and the opaque predicate `SyncAuthorized(state, guarded,
20	requesting_frame)` of WC2 C14. Obligations of `K_C` are hypotheses of theorems, never fields. -/
21	structure KC extends K where
22	  SyncAuthorized : SC → Nat → Nat → Prop
23	
24	/-- Effect of `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C15): a fresh active authority of mode
25	`Modify`, origin `guarded`, footprint `footprint(guarded)`, held by the current frame of `c`;
26	this is the `ok` effect of O1 (Spec 1 §60) on the view of `c`. -/
27	def deriveSyncEff (s : SC) (c g : Nat) : SC :=
28	  s.set (deriveEff (s.view c) g ((s.view c).afp g) .modify)
29	
30	/-- Preconditions of `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C15): those of O1 (Spec 1 §60)
31	for `source = guarded`, `region = footprint(guarded)`, `mode = Modify`, on the view of `c`, with
32	`ExercisableAt(source, Modify)` replaced by `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, current frame)`. -/
33	structure DeriveSyncPre (kc : KC) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) : Prop where
34	  /-- Spec 1 §60.1: `source` is active. -/
35	  active : (s.view c).Active g
36	  /-- WC2 C15, replacing `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)` of Spec 1 §60.1. -/
37	  authorized : kc.SyncAuthorized s g (s.view c).top
38	  /-- Spec 1 §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source` is active. -/
39	  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ (s.view c).ancs g, (s.view c).Active x
40	  /-- Spec 1 §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
41	  leaves : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
42	  /-- Spec 1 §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
43	  within : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ (s.view c).afp g
44	  /-- Spec 1 §60.2: `Modify` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
45	  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, Allows (effective (s.view c) g l) .modify
46	  /-- Spec 1 §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50). -/
47	  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
48	    b ∉ g :: (s.view c).ancs g → (∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ y.footprint) →
49	      y.mode = .observe ∧ Mode.modify = .observe) True
50	  /-- Spec 1 §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
51	  frameLive : (s.view c).top ∈ (s.view c).F
52	
53	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `deriveSync` (WC2 C15). -/
54	instance (kc : KC) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) [Decidable (kc.SyncAuthorized s g (s.view c).top)] :
55	    Decidable (DeriveSyncPre kc s c g) :=
56	  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Active g ∧ kc.SyncAuthorized s g (s.view c).top ∧
57	    (∀ x ∈ (s.view c).ancs g, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
58	    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧
59	    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ (s.view c).afp g) ∧
60	    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, Allows (effective (s.view c) g l) .modify) ∧
61	    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
62	      b ∉ g :: (s.view c).ancs g → (∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ y.footprint) →
63	        y.mode = .observe ∧ Mode.modify = .observe) True) ∧
64	    (s.view c).top ∈ (s.view c).F)
65	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
66	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩
67	
68	/-- `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C15): `ok` or `reject` (Spec 1 §58 for kernel
69	transitions); no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
70	def DeriveSyncStep (kc : KC) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
71	  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DeriveSyncPre kc s c g) (deriveSyncEff s c g) o
72	
73	/-- WC2 C15: the authority created by `deriveSync` is an ordinary authority of mode `Modify`,
74	origin `guarded`, footprint `footprint(guarded)`, held by the current frame, active, of fresh
75	identity `|A|`. -/
76	theorem deriveSync_created {kc : KC} {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat}
77	    (h : DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s')) :
78	    s'.A = s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some g, (s.view c).afp g, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := by
79	  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h
80	  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
81	  rfl
82	
83	/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel (WC2 C2, C4, C6–C8, C15): a step of `CStep`
84	under the projection `K_C.toK`, or `deriveSync`. -/
85	inductive CStepS (kc : KC) : SC → SC → Prop where
86	  | base {s s' : SC} : CStep kc.toK s s' → CStepS kc s s'
87	  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat} : DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s') → CStepS kc s s'
88	
89	end Ern.Concurrency

1	import Ern.Concurrency.Sync

3	/-!
4	# Reference synchronization library
5	
6	Library state separate from `S_C` (WC2 C2, C12), on the pattern of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (Spec
7	1 §46, §55, §56):
8	
9	* the registry of `SyncEntry { guarded, grant }` (WC2 C12), liveness of an entry, the positional
10	  `ControlOf` relationship (WC2 C12) for declared field positions `MutexLayout`;
11	* `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3 and 5) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22);
12	* the library instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized`, limited to registry and controller facts, and
13	  the contract obligation `SyncSound` of WC2 C14 ("unavailable outside the corresponding valid
14	  synchronization contract");
15	* derived operations `newMutex` (C13), `acquire` (C16), `unlock` (C17), `resetLock` (C18);
16	* labelled library steps, runs, and the encapsulation hypothesis `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC2 C22,
17	  C23, C25), a predicate on runs, never a precondition of a kernel operation.
18	-/
19	
20	namespace Ern.Concurrency
21	
22	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
23	
24	/-! ## Registry (WC2 C12) -/
25	
26	/-- Synchronization entry (WC2 C12): the protected authority `guarded` and the recorded grant. -/
27	structure SyncEntry where
28	  guarded : Nat
29	  grant : Option Nat
30	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
31	
32	/-- Synchronization registry (WC2 C12), library state separate from `S_C`. -/
33	abbrev SyncReg := List SyncEntry
34	
35	/-- Declared field positions of the reference mutex value (WC2 C12, "its declared field
36	positions"): the position of the field holding `guarded` and that of the controller, among the
37	ordered children of the mutex value. -/
38	structure MutexLayout where
39	  guardedField : Nat
40	  controlField : Nat
41	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
42	
43	/-- An entry is live exactly while `guarded` is active (WC2 C12). -/
44	def SyncEntry.Live (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop := s.flat.Active e.guarded
45	
46	/-- Decidability of liveness of an entry (WC2 C12). -/
47	instance (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Decidable (e.Live s) := by
48	  unfold SyncEntry.Live; infer_instance
49	
50	/-- Positional `ControlOf` (WC2 C12): `guarded` is held by the field `h` at position
51	`guardedField` of the mutex value `m` (the structural parent of `h`); the controller is the child
52	of `m` at position `controlField`. -/
53	def ControlOf (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Option Nat :=
54	  match (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) with
55	  | some (Holder.place h) =>
56	    match parentOf s.P h with
57	    | some m =>
58	      if (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some h then (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? else none
59	    | none => none
60	  | _ => none
61	
62	/-- The `S3` whose current frame is `f` (WC2 C14: `SyncAuthorized` names the requesting frame;
63	Spec 1 §43 reads the stack only through its top and membership). -/
64	def SC.viewAt (s : SC) (f : Nat) : S3 :=
65	  { s.flat with F := f :: s.frames.filter fun g => decide (g ≠ f) }
66	
67	/-- Controller fact (brief, instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`): the frame `f` has an effective
68	mode on `ControlOf(e)`: some authority exercisable by `f` in a mode at least `Observe` has a
69	present effective mode on the controller (the authority condition of Spec 1 §68.2). -/
70	def CtrlRight (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
71	  OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length,
72	    (s.viewAt f).ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ effective s.flat a ctl ≠ none) False
73	
74	/-- Decidability of the controller fact. -/
75	instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (CtrlRight L s e f) := by
76	  unfold CtrlRight; infer_instance
77	
78	/-- Library authorization for an entry (brief: registry and controller facts only): the entry is
79	live, its grant is available (`grant = none`), and the requesting frame has an effective mode on
80	its controller. -/
81	def EntryAuth (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
82	  e.Live s ∧ e.grant = none ∧ CtrlRight L s e f
83	
84	/-- Decidability of the library authorization of an entry. -/
85	instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (EntryAuth L s e f) := by
86	  unfold EntryAuth; infer_instance
87	
88	/-- Instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, requesting_frame)` by the library (WC2
89	C14, C25; brief: registry and controller facts only): an entry of the registry for `guarded`
90	authorizes the requesting frame. -/
91	def LibSyncAuthorized (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) : Prop :=
92	  ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ EntryAuth L s e f
93	
94	/-- Decidability of the library instantiation. -/
95	instance (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
96	    Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f) := by
97	  unfold LibSyncAuthorized; infer_instance
98	
99	/-- The contract `K_C` instantiated by the library on the registry `reg` (WC2 C14, C25). -/
100	def libKC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) : KC :=
101	  { k with SyncAuthorized := LibSyncAuthorized L reg }
102	
103	/-- Decidability of the instantiated predicate. -/
104	instance (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
105	    Decidable ((libKC k L reg).SyncAuthorized s g f) :=
106	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f))
107	
108	/-- Contract obligation of WC2 C14 ("unavailable outside the corresponding valid synchronization
109	contract"), in state `s` with registry `reg`: `SyncAuthorized` holds only for the `guarded` of a
110	live entry. -/
111	def SyncSound (kc : KC) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) : Prop :=
112	  ∀ g f, kc.SyncAuthorized s g f → ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ e.Live s
113	
114	/-- The library instantiation satisfies the obligation of WC2 C14. -/
115	theorem libKC_sound (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) :
116	    SyncSound (libKC k L reg) reg s :=
117	  fun _ _ ⟨e, he, hg, hl, _⟩ => ⟨e, he, hg, hl⟩
118	
119	/-- The holder is a usable place (WC2 C12, C21.1). -/
120	def PlaceUsable (t : S3) : Holder → Prop
121	  | .place q => t.Usable q
122	  | .frame _ => False
123	
124	/-- Decidability of `PlaceUsable` (WC2 C12). -/
125	instance (t : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (PlaceUsable t h) := by
126	  cases h <;> unfold PlaceUsable <;> infer_instance
127	
128	/-- Spec 1 §65.3 for an authority held by a place `q`: it covers neither a leaf of `q` nor a leaf
129	of storage transitively owned by `q` (WC2 C13.5). -/
130	def StoredOK (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
131	  match y.holder with
132	  | .place q => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∉ footprint P q ∧
133	      ∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, OwnedIn P q r → l ∉ footprint P r
134	  | .frame _ => True
135	
136	/-- Decidability of `StoredOK` (Spec 1 §65.3). -/
137	instance (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Decidable (StoredOK P y) := by
138	  unfold StoredOK; split <;> infer_instance
139	
140	/-! ## Invariants (WC2 C21, C22) -/
141	
142	/-- Active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf, a leaf of `footprint(guarded)`
143	(WC2 C18.2, C22). -/
144	def CoveringDesc (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Prop :=
145	  g ∈ s.flat.ancs j ∧ s.flat.Active j ∧ ∃ l ∈ s.flat.afp j, l ∈ s.flat.afp g
146	
147	/-- Decidability of `CoveringDesc` (WC2 C22). -/
148	instance (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (CoveringDesc s g j) := by
149	  unfold CoveringDesc; infer_instance
150	
151	/-- No active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf (WC2 C18.2, C22). -/
152	def NoCoveringDesc (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Prop := ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ CoveringDesc s g j
153	
154	/-- Decidability of `NoCoveringDesc` (WC2 C22). -/
155	instance (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Decidable (NoCoveringDesc s g) := by
156	  unfold NoCoveringDesc; infer_instance
157	
158	/-- `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22): for every live entry with `grant = none`, no active descendant of
159	`guarded` covers a protected leaf. -/
160	def GrantDiscipline (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
161	  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
162	
163	/-- `SyncInv` (WC2 C21), items 1, 2, 3 and 5. Item 4 ("Registry state and the permitted control
164	operations remain coherent") has no formal content in WC2 and is not formalized (see the
165	report). -/
166	structure SyncInv (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop where
167	  /-- WC2 C21.1: `guarded` is active (liveness), has own mode `Modify`, and is held by a usable
168	  place. -/
169	  guarded : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
170	    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
171	  /-- WC2 C21.2: a recorded grant has origin `guarded` and footprint `footprint(guarded)`. -/
172	  grant : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
173	    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
174	  /-- WC2 C21.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC2 C12: the controller exists and is a usable
175	  leaf. -/
176	  control : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
177	    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
178	  /-- WC2 C21.5 (identity uniqueness among live entries, WC2 C13.7). -/
179	  unique : ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
180	    e.Live s → e'.Live s →
181	    e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
182	
183	/-! ## Derived operations (WC2 C13, C16–C18) -/
184	
185	/-- Preconditions of `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C13), with `adm` the identities used
186	by the other live administrations (Spec 1 §56). Items C13.3 ("non-falsifiable"), C13.4 and C13.6
187	are not formalized (see the report). -/
188	structure NewMutexPreBase (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg)
189	    (c g : Nat) : Prop where
190	  /-- WC2 C13.1: `guarded` is active, of own mode `Modify`, and held by a usable place. -/
191	  guarded : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
192	    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
193	  /-- WC2 C13.2: ordinary exercisable `Modify` over `guarded`. -/
194	  exercisable : (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify
195	  /-- WC2 C13.3 with WC2 C12: the positional `ControlOf` designates a controller, and it is a leaf
196	(WC2 C12: `ControlOf` "identifies the synchronization-control leaf"). -/
197	  control : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => isLeaf s.P ctl) False
198	  /-- WC2 C13.5: when `guarded` is stored (derived), Spec 1 §65.3 holds: it covers neither a leaf
199	  of its holder nor a leaf of storage transitively owned by it. -/
200	  stored : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False
201	  /-- WC2 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live entry. -/
202	  unique : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g
203	  /-- WC2 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live administration. -/
204	  otherAdmin : g ∉ adm
205	  /-- WC2 C13.8: `GrantDiscipline` is established for the new entry. -/
206	  available : NoCoveringDesc s g
207	
208	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `newMutex` (WC2 C13). -/
209	instance (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat) :
210	    Decidable (NewMutexPreBase L adm s reg c g) :=
211	  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
212	      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False ∧
213	    (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify ∧
214	    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
215	    OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False ∧
216	    (∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g) ∧ g ∉ adm ∧ NoCoveringDesc s g)
217	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h⟩,
218	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h⟩⟩
219	
220	/-- `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C13): registers the entry `⟨guarded, none⟩`; the
221	kernel state is unchanged and no authority is created. WC2 C13 states no outcome other than
222	success; only `ok` is defined. -/
223	def NewMutexOk (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat)
224	    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
225	  s.Live c ∧ NewMutexPreBase L adm s reg c g ∧ st' = (s, reg ++ [⟨g, none⟩])
226	
227	/-- `acquire` on entry `i` executed by `c` (WC2 C16): with the library instantiation of
228	`SyncAuthorized` for the entry, `deriveSync(guarded)` and the record of the fresh grant identity
229	`|A|` in the entry. A taken controller (`grant ≠ none`) leaves `acquire` not enabled; WC2 C16
230	states no other outcome than success, so only `ok` is defined. -/
231	def AcquireOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat)
232	    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
233	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ EntryAuth L s e (s.view c).top ∧
234	    DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L reg) s c e.guarded ∧
235	    st' = (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded, reg.set i { e with grant := some s.A.length })
236	
237	/-- `unlock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC2 C17): items 1–4 (item 4 read as the controller
238	fact of the library instantiation); O3 releases the grant and the registry records
239	`grant = none`. Item 5 ("a permitted controller update under its declared shared-mutation
240	discipline") is not formalized (see the report); only `ok` is defined. -/
241	def UnlockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
242	    Prop :=
243	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e g, reg[i]? = some e ∧ e.Live s ∧ e.grant = some g ∧ ReleasePre (s.view c) g ∧
244	    CtrlRight L s e (s.view c).top ∧
245	    st' = (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g), reg.set i { e with grant := none })
246	
247	/-- `resetLock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC2 C18): items 1 and 2; the entry becomes
248	available; the kernel state is unchanged. Item 3 ("a valid, exclusive recovery contract") is not
249	formalized and item 4 is an obligation (see the report); only `ok` is defined. -/
250	def ResetLockOk (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
251	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ (s.view c).ExercisableAt e.guarded .modify ∧
252	    NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded ∧ st' = (s, reg.set i { e with grant := none })
253	
254	/-! ## Labelled steps, runs, encapsulation (WC2 C22, C23, C25) -/
255	
256	/-- Label of a step of the kernel with the synchronization library. -/
257	inductive Label where
258	  | kernel (c : Nat) (op : KernelOp)
259	  | spawn (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
260	  | terminate (c : Nat)
261	  | join (c d : Nat)
262	  | deriveSync (c g : Nat)
263	  | newMutex (c g : Nat) (adm : List Nat)
264	  | acquire (c i : Nat)
265	  | unlock (c i : Nat)
266	  | resetLock (c i : Nat)
267	
268	/-- Labelled `ok` step of the concurrent kernel with the synchronization library (WC2 C2, C4,
269	C6–C8, C13, C15–C18): kernel and frame steps keep the registry; raw `deriveSync` runs under the
270	library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`. -/
271	inductive LStep (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Label → SC × SyncReg → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
272	  | kernel {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} :
273	      opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → LStep k L (.kernel c op) (s, reg) (s', reg)
274	  | spawn {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
275	      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawn c ps ls) (s, reg) (s', reg)
276	  | terminate {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} :
277	      TermStep k s c (.ok s') → LStep k L (.terminate c) (s, reg) (s', reg)
278	  | join {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c d : Nat} :
279	      JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → LStep k L (.join c d) (s, reg) (s', reg)
280	  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} :
281	      DeriveSyncStep (libKC k L reg) s c g (.ok s') → LStep k L (.deriveSync c g) (s, reg) (s', reg)
282	  | newMutex {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} {adm : List Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
283	      NewMutexOk L adm s reg c g st' → LStep k L (.newMutex c g adm) (s, reg) st'
284	  | acquire {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
285	      AcquireOk k L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.acquire c i) (s, reg) st'
286	  | unlock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
287	      UnlockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.unlock c i) (s, reg) st'
288	  | resetLock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
289	      ResetLockOk s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.resetLock c i) (s, reg) st'
290	
291	/-- Encapsulation of one step in state `st` (hypothesis on traces, WC2 C22, C23, C25: the
292	abstraction exposes no safe path compromising its invariant): no inherited `derive` or `split`
293	from, and no raw `deriveSync` of, the `guarded` of a live entry (only `acquire` derives from it);
294	no `transfer` whose source is the place holding the `guarded` of a live entry (the mutex value
295	moves as a whole). -/
296	def Encap (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
297	  | .kernel _ (.derive src _ _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
298	  | .kernel _ (.split src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
299	  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 →
300	      (st.1.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) ≠ some (.place src)
301	  | .deriveSync _ g => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → g ≠ e.guarded
302	  | _ => True
303	
304	/-- Runs of labelled steps. -/
305	inductive LRun (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
306	  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : LRun k L st [] st
307	  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
308	      LStep k L lbl st st₁ → LRun k L st₁ lbls st₂ → LRun k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂
309	
310	/-- `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC2 C22, C23: "preservation of library invariants may be conditional on
311	correct encapsulation, but that condition must be stated"): a run every step of which satisfies
312	`Encap` in the state where it is taken. -/
313	inductive EncapsulatedTrace (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
314	    SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
315	  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : EncapsulatedTrace k L st [] st
316	  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
317	      Encap st lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ → EncapsulatedTrace k L st₁ lbls st₂ →
318	      EncapsulatedTrace k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂
319	
320	/-- An encapsulated trace is a run. -/
321	theorem EncapsulatedTrace.run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
322	    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') : LRun k L st lbls st' := by
323	  induction h with
324	  | nil => exact .nil
325	  | cons _ hs _ ih => exact .cons hs ih
326	
327	/-! ## Theorem 1, last part: `SyncAuthorized` and `deriveSync` without live entry (WC2 C14, C24) -/
328	
329	/-- Theorem 1 (WC2 C14, C24): in a state whose registry has no live entry, the obligation of WC2
330	C14 makes `K_C.SyncAuthorized` false. Fragment: every state, single-context ones included. -/
331	theorem syncAuthorized_false {kc : KC} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC} (hsound : SyncSound kc reg s)
332	    (hnone : ∀ e ∈ reg, ¬ e.Live s) (g f : Nat) : ¬ kc.SyncAuthorized s g f := fun h => by
333	  obtain ⟨e, he, -, hl⟩ := hsound g f h
334	  exact hnone e he hl
335	
336	/-- Theorem 1 (WC2 C15, C24): in a state whose registry has no live entry, under the obligation
337	of WC2 C14, `deriveSync` is never enabled. -/
338	theorem conservative_deriveSync {kc : KC} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC} (hsound : SyncSound kc reg s)
339	    (hnone : ∀ e ∈ reg, ¬ e.Live s) (c g : Nat) (s' : SC) : ¬ DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s') :=
340	  fun ⟨_, h⟩ => syncAuthorized_false hsound hnone g _ (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.authorized
341	
342	/-! ## Theorem 6: exclusivity of grants (Spec 1 §50; WC2 C15) -/
343	
344	/-- An ancestor of an authority whose origin is `g` is `g` or below `g` (Spec 1 §42, §49.5). -/
345	theorem ancs_le_origin {t : S3} (hw : WF3 t) {b g : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : t.A[b]? = some y)
346	    (hyo : y.origin = some g) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ t.ancs b) : x ≤ g := by
347	  have hgb : g < b := hw.origins b y g hy hyo
348	  have horg : t.org b = some g := by simp [S3.org, hy, hyo]
349	  rw [S3.ancs, chain_cons horg hgb] at hx
350	  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
351	  · exact Nat.le_refl _
352	  · exact Nat.le_of_lt (chain_lt hx)
353	
354	/-- Theorem 6 (Spec 1 §50, I1; WC2 C15, C21.2): two distinct active authorities of own mode
355	`Modify` whose origin is the same `guarded` and whose footprint is `footprint(guarded)`, nonempty,
356	cannot coexist. Fragment: states satisfying `WF3` and `I1` on the globally live frames. -/
357	theorem grants_exclusive {s : SC} (hw : WF3 s.flat) (h1 : I1 s.flat) {g a b : Nat}
358	    {x y : Authority} (hab : a ≠ b) (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) (hy : s.A[b]? = some y)
359	    (xa : x.active = true) (ya : y.active = true) (xm : x.mode = .modify)
360	    (xo : x.origin = some g) (yo : y.origin = some g)
361	    (xf : ∀ l, l ∈ x.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp g) (yf : ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp g)
362	    {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ s.flat.afp g) : False := by
363	  have hga : g < a := hw.origins a x g hx xo
364	  have hgb : g < b := hw.origins b y g hy yo
365	  have hna : a ∉ s.flat.ancs b := fun h => by have := ancs_le_origin hw hy yo h; omega
366	  have hnb : b ∉ s.flat.ancs a := fun h => by have := ancs_le_origin hw hx xo h; omega
367	  have := h1 a b x y l hab hx hy xa ya ((xf l).2 hl) ((yf l).2 hl) hna hnb
368	  rw [xm] at this; cases this.1
369	
370	/-! ## Theorem 5: realizability (WC2 C25) -/
371	
372	/-- Theorem 5 (WC2 C14, C15, C25): under `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline`, and the kernel invariant
373	re-indexed (`KInvC`: `WF3`, `I1` and `I2` are used), the library instantiation of
374	`SyncAuthorized` (registry and controller facts only) for the current frame of a live context
375	entails that no active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf and all the preconditions
376	of `deriveSync`, in particular I1 for the full-footprint grant (§60.3) and the validity of the
377	origin chain (§60.1). Fragment: states satisfying `KInvC`. -/
378	theorem realizability {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC} {c g : Nat}
379	    (hk : KInvC s) (hsi : SyncInv L s reg) (hgd : GrantDiscipline s reg) (hc : s.stk c ≠ [])
380	    (ha : LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g (s.view c).top) :
381	    NoCoveringDesc s g ∧ DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L reg) s c g := by
382	  obtain ⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩, -, -⟩, -, -⟩ := hk
383	  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl, hl, hn, hcr⟩ := ha
384	  have hnc := hgd e he hl hn
385	  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hl
386	  have hy' : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
387	  have hym : y.mode = .modify := by
388	    have := hsi.guarded e he ⟨y, hy, ya⟩; simp only [OptP, hy'] at this; exact this.1
389	  have hfp : s.flat.afp e.guarded = y.footprint := by simp [S3.afp, hy]
390	  have hafp : ∀ {j : Nat} {z : Authority}, s.A[j]? = some z → s.flat.afp j = z.footprint :=
391	    fun hz => by simp [S3.afp, SC.flat, hz]
392	  refine ⟨hnc, ⟨y, hy, ya⟩, ⟨e, he, rfl, ⟨y, hy, ya⟩, hn, hcr⟩, ?_, ?_, fun l h => h, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
393	  · exact I2.ancs_active h2 ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
394	  · intro l hl'
395	    have hl'' : l ∈ y.footprint := by rw [← hfp]; exact hl'
396	    exact hw.footprints _ y hy l hl''
397	  · intro l hl'
398	    have hl'' : l ∈ y.footprint := by rw [← hfp]; exact hl'
399	    have hd : descModes s.flat e.guarded l = [] := by
400	      apply nil_of_forall_not_mem
401	      intro m hm
402	      obtain ⟨j, z, hz, za, hlz, hanc, -⟩ := mem_descModes.1 hm
403	      exact hnc j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
404	        ⟨hanc, ⟨z, hz, za⟩, l, by rw [hafp hz]; exact hlz, hl'⟩
405	    change Allows (effective s.flat e.guarded l) .modify
406	    rw [effective_eq hy ya hl'', hd, hym]
407	    simp [effOf, Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
408	  · intro b _
409	    unfold OptP; split
410	    · rename_i z hz
411	      intro za hnb hcov
412	      exfalso
413	      obtain ⟨l, hl', hlz⟩ := hcov
414	      have hb : b ≠ e.guarded := fun h => hnb (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
415	      have hnanc : b ∉ s.flat.ancs e.guarded := fun h => hnb (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
416	      by_cases hdesc : e.guarded ∈ s.flat.ancs b
417	      · exact hnc b (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz)) ⟨hdesc, ⟨z, hz, za⟩, l,
418	          by rw [hafp hz]; exact hlz, hl'⟩
419	      · have hl'' : l ∈ y.footprint := by rw [← hfp]; exact hl'
420	        have := h1 e.guarded b y z l (Ne.symm hb) hy hz ya za hl'' hlz hdesc hnanc
421	        rw [hym] at this; cases this.1
422	    · trivial
423	  · obtain ⟨f, rest, hf⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hc
424	    simp [SC.view, S3.top, hf]
425	
426	end Ern.Concurrency

3	/-!
4	# Provisional by-value transmission at `spawn` (WC2 C5)
5	
6	The composite of WC2 C5: `spawn` (WC2 C4) creating, among the locals of the new frame, a fresh
7	root `destination`, and the transfer of an owned `source` of the creator into it, with the
8	preconditions of O4 (Spec 1 §63) except the destination side of §63.1, replaced by WC2 C5.2–C5.3.
9	
10	WC2 C5.4 evaluates the resulting-state conditions of O4 on the final state but does not say in
11	which state the other conditions are evaluated. Two of them depend on it: the source side of
12	§63.1 (exercisable `Modify` of the creating frame over the source, WC2 C5.1) and §63.4 (the
13	exemption of the grounding authority), since the spawn part moves the transmitted parameters to
14	the new frame. Both readings are defined (`SrcRightBefore`, `SrcRightAfterSpawn`) and
15	`readings_differ` exhibits a state where every other clause holds and the two readings disagree.
16	The composite relation itself is not defined: its definition requires that choice (see the
17	report).
18	-/
19	
20	namespace Ern.Concurrency
21	
22	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
23	
24	/-- Effect of the composite (WC2 C5 effect): the effect of `spawn` (WC2 C4), then the effect of
25	O4 (Spec 1 §63) from `src` to `dst` on the resulting state. -/
26	def spawnValEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (src dst : Nat) : SC :=
27	  (spawnEff s c ps ls).set (transferEff (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src dst)
28	
29	/-- WC2 C5.2: `dst` is a fresh root local of the initial frame of the new context (its leaves are
30	`Uninit`, it holds no derived authority and its root authority is held by that frame by
31	construction of `spawnEff`). -/
32	def FreshRootLocal (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
33	  ∃ i ∈ rootIdx ls.toShape, dst = s.P.length + i
34	
35	/-- Decidability of `FreshRootLocal` (WC2 C5.2). -/
36	instance (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (FreshRootLocal s ls dst) := by
37	  unfold FreshRootLocal; infer_instance
38	
39	/-- Clauses of the composite whose state of evaluation is fixed by WC2 C4 and C5: C4.1, C4.3,
40	C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2); C5.2; the source side of §63.1 without the right (usability); §63.2, §63.3,
41	§63.5, §63.6 (first half) and §63.8 on the state where the destination exists, after the spawn
42	part; the resulting-state conditions §63.6 (second half), §63.7 and §63.9 on the final state
43	(WC2 C5.4). Not included: the source right of §63.1 and §63.4 (two readings below), the
44	resulting-state conditions of WC2 C4.5–C4.6 (state of evaluation not fixed by WC2: after the
45	spawn part or after the composite) and WC2 C4.6, C5.8 ("invariants hold", see the report). -/
46	structure SpawnValPreBase (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
47	    (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
48	  /-- WC2 C4.1: the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
49	  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
50	  /-- WC2 C4.3: every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by the creating
51	  frame. -/
52	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
53	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
54	  /-- WC2 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
55	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
56	  /-- WC2 C5.2: the destination is a fresh root local of the new frame. -/
57	  freshDst : FreshRootLocal s ls dst
58	  /-- WC2 C5.1 (Spec 1 §63.1): the source is usable. -/
59	  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
60	  /-- WC2 C5.5 (Spec 1 §63.2): same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
61	  sameShape : SameShape (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst
62	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
63	  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l = .init
64	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3, WC2 C5.2: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
65	  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P dst, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l ≠ .init
66	  /-- WC2 C5.5 (Spec 1 §63.3): disjoint footprints. -/
67	  disjoint : ¬ overlap (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst
68	  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned. -/
69	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧
70	    (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.pin l = false
71	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
72	  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.Active x
73	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed, WC2 C5.4: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
74	  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst)
75	  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed, WC2 C5.4: moved held authorities satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
76	  `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
77	  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).A.length,
78	    AnchorMoves (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src x → ∀ q ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).P.length,
79	      (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable q →
80	      OptP ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
81	        y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst) x
82	          ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.pframe q)) True
83	  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
84	  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src dst
85	  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: the destination is usable in the final state. -/
86	  dstUsableAfter : (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable dst
87	
88	/-- Decidability of `SpawnValPreBase` (WC2 C5). -/
89	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
90	    (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SpawnValPreBase k s c ps ls src dst) :=
91	  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
92	      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
93	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ FreshRootLocal s ls dst ∧ (s.view c).Usable src ∧
94	    SameShape (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst ∧
95	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l = .init) ∧
96	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P dst, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l ≠ .init) ∧
97	    ¬ overlap (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst ∧
98	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧
99	      (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.pin l = false) ∧
100	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.Active x) ∧
101	    AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst) ∧
102	    (∀ x ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).A.length,
103	      AnchorMoves (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src x → ∀ q ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).P.length,
104	        (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable q →
105	        OptP ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
106	          y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst) x
107	            ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.pframe q)) True) ∧
108	    NoLocalSelfLock (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src dst ∧
109	    (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable dst)
110	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
111	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
112	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
113	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩
114	
115	/-- Source side of Spec 1 §63.1 and §63.4 for the creating context `c` in state `t` (WC2 C5.1,
116	C5.4): exercisable `Modify` over the source, and no active derived authority covering a source
117	leaf from outside the source except some grounding authority and its origin chain. -/
118	def SrcRight (t : SC) (c src : Nat) : Prop :=
119	  HasRight (t.view c) .modify src ∧
120	  ∃ g ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, Grounds (t.view c) .modify src g ∧
121	    ∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (t.view c) src j →
122	      RightChain (t.view c) g j
123	
124	/-- Decidability of `SrcRight` (Spec 1 §63.1, §63.4). -/
125	instance (t : SC) (c src : Nat) : Decidable (SrcRight t c src) := by
126	  unfold SrcRight; infer_instance
127	
128	/-- Reading (a) of WC2 C5.1, C5.4: the source clauses are evaluated in the state before the
129	composite. -/
130	def SrcRightBefore (s : SC) (c src : Nat) : Prop := SrcRight s c src
131	
132	/-- Reading (b) of WC2 C5.1, C5.4: the source clauses are evaluated after the spawn part, when
133	the transmitted parameters are held by the new frame. -/
134	def SrcRightAfterSpawn (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (src : Nat) :
135	    Prop :=
136	  SrcRight (spawnEff s c ps ls) c src
137	
138	/-- Decidability of reading (a) (WC2 C5.4). -/
139	instance (s : SC) (c src : Nat) : Decidable (SrcRightBefore s c src) := by
140	  unfold SrcRightBefore; infer_instance
141	
142	/-- Decidability of reading (b) (WC2 C5.4). -/
143	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (src : Nat) :
144	    Decidable (SrcRightAfterSpawn s c ps ls src) := by
145	  unfold SrcRightAfterSpawn; infer_instance

5	/-!
6	# Minimal traces (test module)
7	
8	Concrete states and runs used by the theorems of the concurrent milestone (constructions and
9	counterexamples), checked by `decide`. The corpus of WC2 §V (S1a–S15) is not covered here.
10	
11	* a mutex value `m = {data, lock}` whose field `data` owns the protected storage `T` (WC2 C13,
12	  reference representation), its registration by `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`;
13	* theorem 4, counterexample without encapsulation: `derive(guarded, Observe, footprint(T))` by the
14	  exclusive owner makes `acquire` not enabled while `grant = none` (`acquire_blocked_by_derive`);
15	  the encapsulated twin enables it (`acquire_enabled`);
16	* theorem 5 needs the kernel invariant: a state with `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and the library
17	  instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`, violating `I1`, where `deriveSync` is not enabled
18	  (`realizability_needs_i1`);
19	* frame transitions: `enterFrame`, `spawn`, `exitFrameC` with reparenting, `terminate`, `join`
20	  (`frames_run`), and `join` on a live context has no outcome (`join_waits`);
21	* two `newMutex` on two protected roots owned by the same field share one controller
22	  (`shared_controller`, report).
23	-/

29	/-! ## Mutex value (WC2 C12, C13) -/
30	
31	/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `m`, `1` its field `data`, `2` its field `lock`, `3`
32	the protected value `T`, a root owned by `data`; every leaf `Init`. -/
33	def mst : Statics :=
34	  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
35	   ((none, some 1, 0), true)]
36	
37	/-- The reference layout (WC2 C12): `guarded` is held by the first field, the controller is the
38	second. -/
39	def L0 : MutexLayout := ⟨0, 1⟩
40	
41	/-- Initial single-context state (Spec 1 §47): root authority `0` of `m` held by frame 0, root
42	authority `1` of `T` held by `data` (place 1). -/
43	def c0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst)
44	
45	/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
46	theorem mst_ok : StaticsOK mst := by decide
47	
48	/-- After `newMutex(guarded = 1)` (WC2 C13). -/
49	def reg1 : SyncReg := [⟨1, none⟩]
50	
51	/-- `newMutex(1)` executed by context 0 is enabled on `c0`; its controller is place 2. -/
52	theorem newMutex_ok : NewMutexOk L0 [] c0 [] 0 1 (c0, reg1) ∧
53	    ControlOf L0 c0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 :=
54	  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide⟩
55	
56	/-! ## Theorem 4: counterexample without encapsulation (WC2 C22) -/
57	
58	/-- `derive(guarded = 1, footprint(T) = [3], Observe)` by context 0, the exclusive owner. -/
59	def c1 : SC := c0.set (deriveEff (c0.view 0) 1 [3] .observe)
60	
61	/-- The derivation is an enabled kernel step (Spec 1 §60) and it is not encapsulated. -/
62	theorem derive_step : opStepC K0 (.derive 1 [3] .observe) 0 c0 (.ok c1) ∧
63	    ¬ Encap (c0, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .observe)) :=
64	  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, fun h => h ⟨1, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl⟩
65	
66	/-- Theorem 4, second half (WC2 C22): after the non-encapsulated `derive`, the entry is live with
67	`grant = none`, `GrantDiscipline` fails, and `acquire` is not enabled. -/
68	theorem acquire_blocked_by_derive : (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live c1 ∧ ¬ GrantDiscipline c1 reg1 ∧
69	    ∀ st', ¬ AcquireOk K0 L0 c1 reg1 0 0 st' := by
70	  refine ⟨by decide, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
71	  · have := h ⟨1, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl
72	    exact (by decide : ¬ NoCoveringDesc c1 1) this
73	  · rintro st' ⟨-, e, he, -, hd, -⟩
74	    simp only [reg1, List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at he
75	    subst he
76	    exact (by decide : ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC K0 L0 reg1) c1 0 1) hd
77	
78	/-- The grant created by `acquire` on `c0` (WC2 C15, C16). -/
79	def c2 : SC := deriveSyncEff c0 0 1
80	
81	/-- Registry after `acquire` (WC2 C16): the grant is authority 2. -/
82	def reg2 : SyncReg := [⟨1, some 2⟩]
83	
84	/-- Positive twin (WC2 C16): without the derivation, `acquire` is enabled and records the grant. -/
85	theorem acquire_enabled : AcquireOk K0 L0 c0 reg1 0 0 (c2, reg2) :=
86	  ⟨by decide, ⟨1, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
87	
88	/-- State after `unlock` (WC2 C17). -/
89	def c3 : SC := c2.set (releaseEff (c2.view 0) 2)
90	
91	/-- `unlock` is enabled after `acquire` (WC2 C17). -/
92	theorem unlock_enabled : UnlockOk L0 c2 reg2 0 0 (c3, reg1) :=
93	  ⟨by decide, ⟨1, some 2⟩, 2, rfl, by decide, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
94	
95	/-- An encapsulated trace `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock` from `c0` with an empty registry (WC2
96	C13, C16, C17, C22). -/
97	theorem mutex_trace : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (c0, [])
98	    [.newMutex 0 1 [], .acquire 0 0, .unlock 0 0] (c3, reg1) :=
99	  .cons trivial (.newMutex newMutex_ok.1) <|
100	  .cons trivial (.acquire acquire_enabled) <|
101	  .cons trivial (.unlock unlock_enabled) .nil

103	/-! ## Theorem 5 needs the kernel invariant (WC2 C25; Spec 1 §50) -/
104	
105	/-- `c0` with an extra active root `Modify` authority over `T` held by frame 0, unrelated to
106	`guarded` (violates I1, Spec 1 §50). -/
107	def bad : SC := { c0 with A := c0.A ++ [⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 0, true⟩] }
108	
109	/-- Theorem 5 is false without the kernel invariant: in `bad`, `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and
110	the library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` hold for the current frame of context 0, `I1`
111	fails, and the preconditions of `deriveSync` fail (Spec 1 §60.3). -/
112	theorem realizability_needs_i1 : SyncInv L0 bad reg1 ∧ GrantDiscipline bad reg1 ∧
113	    LibSyncAuthorized L0 reg1 bad 1 (bad.view 0).top ∧ ¬ I1 bad.flat ∧
114	    ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC K0 L0 reg1) bad 0 1 := by
115	  have hl : ∀ {i : Nat} {e : SyncEntry}, reg1[i]? = some e → i = 0 ∧ e = ⟨1, none⟩ := by
116	    intro i e h
117	    cases i with
118	    | zero => simp [reg1] at h; exact ⟨rfl, h.symm⟩
119	    | succ i => simp [reg1] at h
120	  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, by decide, fun h => ?_, by decide⟩
121	  · intro e he _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
122	  · intro e he _ g hg; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; cases hg
123	  · intro e he _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
124	  · intro i j e e' hi hj _ _ _; rw [(hl hi).1, (hl hj).1]
125	  · intro e he _ _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
126	  · have := h 1 2 ⟨.modify, none, [3], .place 1, true⟩ ⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ 3
127	      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
128	    cases this.1

130	/-! ## Frame transitions (WC2 C4, C6–C8) -/
131	
132	/-- Context 0 enters a call frame (frame 1) without parameter nor local (Spec 1 §72). -/
133	def f1 : SC := enterEffC c0 0 [] []
134	/-- From frame 1, context 0 spawns context 1 (frame 2, parent 1) with one local (place 4) (WC2
135	C4). -/
136	def f2 : SC := spawnEff f1 0 [] [(none, 0)]
137	/-- Frame 1 exits; context 1 is reparented to frame 0 (WC2 C6). -/
138	def f3 : SC := exitEffC f2 0
139	/-- Context 1 terminates (WC2 C7). -/
140	def f4 : SC := termEffC f3 1
141	
142	/-- A run of frame transitions (WC2 C4, C6–C8): `enterFrame`, `spawn`, `exitFrameC` (reparenting
143	context 1 from the exiting frame 1 to its caller 0), `terminate`, `join`. -/
144	theorem frames_run : opStepC K0 (.enter [] []) 0 c0 (.ok f1) ∧ SpawnStep f1 0 [] [(none, 0)] (.ok f2) ∧
145	    f2.ctxParent 1 = some 1 ∧ opStepC K0 .exit 0 f2 (.ok f3) ∧ f3.ctxParent 1 = some 0 ∧
146	    TermStep K0 f3 1 (.ok f4) ∧ JoinStep f4 0 1 (.ok f4) := by
147	  refine ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide,
148	    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, .ok (by decide) ?_⟩
149	  decide
150	
151	/-- WC2 C8 (brief: waiting is a non-enabled transition): while context 1 is live, `join` has no
152	outcome. -/
153	theorem join_waits : ∀ o, ¬ JoinStep f3 0 1 o := by
154	  intro o h
155	  cases h with
156	  | ok _ hd => exact (by decide : ¬ OptP (f3.C[1]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False) hd
157	
158	/-- `ancestorC` across contexts after `spawn` (WC2 C3): the creating frame 1 and the base frame 0
159	are ancestors of the initial frame 2 of context 1; after `exitFrameC`, frame 0 still is. -/
160	theorem ancestry : f2.ancestorC 1 2 ∧ f2.ancestorC 0 2 ∧ ¬ f2.ancestorC 2 1 ∧
161	    f3.ancestorC 0 2 ∧ ¬ f3.ancestorC 1 2 := by decide
162	
163	/-! ## Non-vacuity of the re-indexed kernel invariant (WC2 C20) -/
164	
165	/-- `FramesC` from bounded, decidable clauses (decision procedure for WC2 C3). -/
166	theorem framesC_of {s : SC} (h0 : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False)
167	    (hne : ∀ c ∈ List.range s.C.length, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []) (hnd : s.frames.Nodup)
168	    (hb : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF)
169	    (hr : ∀ c ∈ List.range s.C.length, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none)
170	    (hp : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, OptP (s.parC f) (fun g => g ∈ s.frames ∧ g < f) True) : FramesC s := by
171	  have hlt : ∀ c, s.Live c → c < s.C.length := fun c hc => by
172	    unfold SC.Live at hc; unfold OptP at hc; split at hc
173	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
174	    · exact hc.elim
175	  refine ⟨h0, fun c hc => hne c (List.mem_range.2 (hlt c hc)) hc, hnd, hb,
176	    fun c h0 hc => hr c (List.mem_range.2 (hlt c hc)) h0 hc, fun f hf g hg => ?_⟩
177	  have := hp f hf; rw [hg] at this; exact this
178	
179	/-- The initial single-context state satisfies the re-indexed kernel invariant (WC2 C20, C24). -/
180	theorem c0_kInvC : KInvC c0 := by
181	  refine (single_kInvC ⟨_, rfl⟩).2 ⟨framesC_of (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
182	    (by decide) (by decide), ?_⟩
183	  exact (init_kinv mst_ok).1

185	/-- The two-context state `f2` (after `spawn` from a call frame) satisfies the re-indexed kernel

187	theorem f2_kInvC : KInvC f2 := by
188	  have hk := (Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.KInvB.sound (s := f2.flat) (by decide)).1
189	  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩, -, hno⟩ := hk
190	  exact ⟨⟨framesC_of (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), hw⟩,
191	    ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, fun _ => i4_always _⟩, by decide, hnd⟩, by decide, hno⟩
192	
193	/-! ## Two entries sharing a controller (report, WC2 C12 and C13) -/
194	
195	/-- Statics: the mutex value `m = {data, lock}` and two protected roots `T₁`, `T₂` both owned by
196	`data`. -/
197	def mst2 : Statics :=
198	  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
199	   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]
200	
201	/-- Initial state: root authorities 1 (of `T₁`) and 2 (of `T₂`) are both held by `data`. -/
202	def d0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst2)
203	
204	/-- WC2 C12 requires distinct controller associations for different mutex instances; the
205	preconditions formalized from WC2 C13 accept `newMutex(1)` then `newMutex(2)`, and both entries
206	have the same positional controller (place 2). -/
207	theorem shared_controller : NewMutexOk L0 [] d0 [] 0 1 (d0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧
208	    NewMutexOk L0 [] d0 [⟨1, none⟩] 0 2 (d0, [⟨1, none⟩, ⟨2, none⟩]) ∧
209	    ControlOf L0 d0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 d0 ⟨2, none⟩ = some 2 :=
210	  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide, by decide⟩
