1	import Ern.Concurrency.Frames
2	
3	/-!
4	# Provisional by-value transmission at `spawn` (WC2 C5)
5	
6	The composite of WC2 C5: `spawn` (WC2 C4) creating, among the locals of the new frame, a fresh
7	root `destination`, and the transfer of an owned `source` of the creator into it, with the
8	preconditions of O4 (Spec 1 §63) except the destination side of §63.1, replaced by WC2 C5.2–C5.3.
9	
10	WC2 C5.4 evaluates the resulting-state conditions of O4 on the final state but does not say in
11	which state the other conditions are evaluated. Two of them depend on it: the source side of
12	§63.1 (exercisable `Modify` of the creating frame over the source, WC2 C5.1) and §63.4 (the
13	exemption of the grounding authority), since the spawn part moves the transmitted parameters to
14	the new frame. Both readings are defined (`SrcRightBefore`, `SrcRightAfterSpawn`) and
15	`readings_differ` exhibits a state where every other clause holds and the two readings disagree.
16	The composite relation itself is not defined: its definition requires that choice (see the
17	report).
18	-/
19	
20	namespace Ern.Concurrency
21	
22	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
23	
24	/-- Effect of the composite (WC2 C5 effect): the effect of `spawn` (WC2 C4), then the effect of
25	O4 (Spec 1 §63) from `src` to `dst` on the resulting state. -/
26	def spawnValEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (src dst : Nat) : SC :=
27	  (spawnEff s c ps ls).set (transferEff (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src dst)
28	
29	/-- WC2 C5.2: `dst` is a fresh root local of the initial frame of the new context (its leaves are
30	`Uninit`, it holds no derived authority and its root authority is held by that frame by
31	construction of `spawnEff`). -/
32	def FreshRootLocal (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
33	  ∃ i ∈ rootIdx ls.toShape, dst = s.P.length + i
34	
35	/-- Decidability of `FreshRootLocal` (WC2 C5.2). -/
36	instance (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (FreshRootLocal s ls dst) := by
37	  unfold FreshRootLocal; infer_instance
38	
39	/-- Clauses of the composite whose state of evaluation is fixed by WC2 C4 and C5: C4.1, C4.3,
40	C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2); C5.2; the source side of §63.1 without the right (usability); §63.2, §63.3,
41	§63.5, §63.6 (first half) and §63.8 on the state where the destination exists, after the spawn
42	part; the resulting-state conditions §63.6 (second half), §63.7 and §63.9 on the final state
43	(WC2 C5.4). Not included: the source right of §63.1 and §63.4 (two readings below), the
44	resulting-state conditions of WC2 C4.5–C4.6 (state of evaluation not fixed by WC2: after the
45	spawn part or after the composite) and WC2 C4.6, C5.8 ("invariants hold", see the report). -/
46	structure SpawnValPreBase (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
47	    (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
48	  /-- WC2 C4.1: the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
49	  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
50	  /-- WC2 C4.3: every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by the creating
51	  frame. -/
52	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
53	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
54	  /-- WC2 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
55	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
56	  /-- WC2 C5.2: the destination is a fresh root local of the new frame. -/
57	  freshDst : FreshRootLocal s ls dst
58	  /-- WC2 C5.1 (Spec 1 §63.1): the source is usable. -/
59	  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
60	  /-- WC2 C5.5 (Spec 1 §63.2): same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
61	  sameShape : SameShape (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst
62	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
63	  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l = .init
64	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3, WC2 C5.2: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
65	  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P dst, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l ≠ .init
66	  /-- WC2 C5.5 (Spec 1 §63.3): disjoint footprints. -/
67	  disjoint : ¬ overlap (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst
68	  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned. -/
69	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧
70	    (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.pin l = false
71	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
72	  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.Active x
73	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed, WC2 C5.4: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
74	  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst)
75	  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed, WC2 C5.4: moved held authorities satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
76	  `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
77	  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).A.length,
78	    AnchorMoves (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src x → ∀ q ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).P.length,
79	      (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable q →
80	      OptP ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
81	        y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst) x
82	          ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.pframe q)) True
83	  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
84	  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src dst
85	  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: the destination is usable in the final state. -/
86	  dstUsableAfter : (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable dst
87	
88	/-- Decidability of `SpawnValPreBase` (WC2 C5). -/
89	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
90	    (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SpawnValPreBase k s c ps ls src dst) :=
91	  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
92	      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
93	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ FreshRootLocal s ls dst ∧ (s.view c).Usable src ∧
94	    SameShape (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst ∧
95	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l = .init) ∧
96	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P dst, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l ≠ .init) ∧
97	    ¬ overlap (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst ∧
98	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧
99	      (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.pin l = false) ∧
100	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.Active x) ∧
101	    AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst) ∧
102	    (∀ x ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).A.length,
103	      AnchorMoves (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src x → ∀ q ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).P.length,
104	        (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable q →
105	        OptP ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
106	          y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst) x
107	            ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.pframe q)) True) ∧
108	    NoLocalSelfLock (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src dst ∧
109	    (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable dst)
110	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
111	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
112	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
113	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩
114	
115	/-- Source side of Spec 1 §63.1 and §63.4 for the creating context `c` in state `t` (WC2 C5.1,
116	C5.4): exercisable `Modify` over the source, and no active derived authority covering a source
117	leaf from outside the source except some grounding authority and its origin chain. -/
118	def SrcRight (t : SC) (c src : Nat) : Prop :=
119	  HasRight (t.view c) .modify src ∧
120	  ∃ g ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, Grounds (t.view c) .modify src g ∧
121	    ∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (t.view c) src j →
122	      RightChain (t.view c) g j
123	
124	/-- Decidability of `SrcRight` (Spec 1 §63.1, §63.4). -/
125	instance (t : SC) (c src : Nat) : Decidable (SrcRight t c src) := by
126	  unfold SrcRight; infer_instance
127	
128	/-- Reading (a) of WC2 C5.1, C5.4: the source clauses are evaluated in the state before the
129	composite. -/
130	def SrcRightBefore (s : SC) (c src : Nat) : Prop := SrcRight s c src
131	
132	/-- Reading (b) of WC2 C5.1, C5.4: the source clauses are evaluated after the spawn part, when
133	the transmitted parameters are held by the new frame. -/
134	def SrcRightAfterSpawn (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (src : Nat) :
135	    Prop :=
136	  SrcRight (spawnEff s c ps ls) c src
137	
138	/-- Decidability of reading (a) (WC2 C5.4). -/
139	instance (s : SC) (c src : Nat) : Decidable (SrcRightBefore s c src) := by
140	  unfold SrcRightBefore; infer_instance
141	
142	/-- Decidability of reading (b) (WC2 C5.4). -/
143	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (src : Nat) :
144	    Decidable (SrcRightAfterSpawn s c ps ls src) := by
145	  unfold SrcRightAfterSpawn; infer_instance
146

5	/-!
6	# Minimal traces (test module)
7	
8	Concrete states and runs used by the theorems of the concurrent milestone (constructions and
9	counterexamples), checked by `decide`. The corpus of WC2 §V (S1a–S15) is not covered here.
10	
11	* a mutex value `m = {data, lock}` whose field `data` owns the protected storage `T` (WC2 C13,
12	  reference representation), its registration by `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`;
13	* theorem 4, counterexample without encapsulation: `derive(guarded, Observe, footprint(T))` by the
14	  exclusive owner makes `acquire` not enabled while `grant = none` (`acquire_blocked_by_derive`);
15	  the encapsulated twin enables it (`acquire_enabled`);
16	* theorem 5 needs the kernel invariant: a state with `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and the library
17	  instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`, violating `I1`, where `deriveSync` is not enabled
18	  (`realizability_needs_i1`);
19	* frame transitions: `enterFrame`, `spawn`, `exitFrameC` with reparenting, `terminate`, `join`
20	  (`frames_run`), and `join` on a live context has no outcome (`join_waits`);
21	* two `newMutex` on two protected roots owned by the same field share one controller
22	  (`shared_controller`, report).
23	-/

29	/-! ## Mutex value (WC2 C12, C13) -/

31	/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `m`, `1` its field `data`, `2` its field `lock`, `3`
32	the protected value `T`, a root owned by `data`; every leaf `Init`. -/
33	def mst : Statics :=
34	  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
35	   ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

38	second. -/

42	authority `1` of `T` held by `data` (place 1). -/

53	    ControlOf L0 c0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 :=

56	/-! ## Theorem 4: counterexample without encapsulation (WC2 C22) -/
57	
58	/-- `derive(guarded = 1, footprint(T) = [3], Observe)` by context 0, the exclusive owner. -/

62	theorem derive_step : opStepC K0 (.derive 1 [3] .observe) 0 c0 (.ok c1) ∧
63	    ¬ Encap (c0, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .observe)) :=
64	  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, fun h => h ⟨1, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl⟩

67	`grant = none`, `GrantDiscipline` fails, and `acquire` is not enabled. -/
68	theorem acquire_blocked_by_derive : (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live c1 ∧ ¬ GrantDiscipline c1 reg1 ∧
69	    ∀ st', ¬ AcquireOk K0 L0 c1 reg1 0 0 st' := by
70	  refine ⟨by decide, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
71	  · have := h ⟨1, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl
72	    exact (by decide : ¬ NoCoveringDesc c1 1) this
73	  · rintro st' ⟨-, e, he, -, hd, -⟩
74	    simp only [reg1, List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at he
75	    subst he
76	    exact (by decide : ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC K0 L0 reg1) c1 0 1) hd

85	theorem acquire_enabled : AcquireOk K0 L0 c0 reg1 0 0 (c2, reg2) :=

96	C13, C16, C17, C22). -/

100	  .cons trivial (.acquire acquire_enabled) <|

103	/-! ## Theorem 5 needs the kernel invariant (WC2 C25; Spec 1 §50) -/
104	
105	/-- `c0` with an extra active root `Modify` authority over `T` held by frame 0, unrelated to
106	`guarded` (violates I1, Spec 1 §50). -/
107	def bad : SC := { c0 with A := c0.A ++ [⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 0, true⟩] }
108	
109	/-- Theorem 5 is false without the kernel invariant: in `bad`, `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and
110	the library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` hold for the current frame of context 0, `I1`
111	fails, and the preconditions of `deriveSync` fail (Spec 1 §60.3). -/
112	theorem realizability_needs_i1 : SyncInv L0 bad reg1 ∧ GrantDiscipline bad reg1 ∧
113	    LibSyncAuthorized L0 reg1 bad 1 (bad.view 0).top ∧ ¬ I1 bad.flat ∧
114	    ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC K0 L0 reg1) bad 0 1 := by
115	  have hl : ∀ {i : Nat} {e : SyncEntry}, reg1[i]? = some e → i = 0 ∧ e = ⟨1, none⟩ := by
116	    intro i e h
117	    cases i with
118	    | zero => simp [reg1] at h; exact ⟨rfl, h.symm⟩
119	    | succ i => simp [reg1] at h
120	  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, by decide, fun h => ?_, by decide⟩
121	  · intro e he _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
122	  · intro e he _ g hg; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; cases hg
123	  · intro e he _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
124	  · intro i j e e' hi hj _ _ _; rw [(hl hi).1, (hl hj).1]
125	  · intro e he _ _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
126	  · have := h 1 2 ⟨.modify, none, [3], .place 1, true⟩ ⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ 3
127	      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
128	    cases this.1

132	/-- Context 0 enters a call frame (frame 1) without parameter nor local (Spec 1 §72). -/
133	def f1 : SC := enterEffC c0 0 [] []

138	def f3 : SC := exitEffC f2 0

143	context 1 from the exiting frame 1 to its caller 0), `terminate`, `join`. -/
144	theorem frames_run : opStepC K0 (.enter [] []) 0 c0 (.ok f1) ∧ SpawnStep f1 0 [] [(none, 0)] (.ok f2) ∧
145	    f2.ctxParent 1 = some 1 ∧ opStepC K0 .exit 0 f2 (.ok f3) ∧ f3.ctxParent 1 = some 0 ∧
146	    TermStep K0 f3 1 (.ok f4) ∧ JoinStep f4 0 1 (.ok f4) := by
147	  refine ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide,
148	    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, .ok (by decide) ?_⟩
149	  decide

165	/-- `FramesC` from bounded, decidable clauses (decision procedure for WC2 C3). -/
166	theorem framesC_of {s : SC} (h0 : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False)
167	    (hne : ∀ c ∈ List.range s.C.length, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []) (hnd : s.frames.Nodup)
168	    (hb : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF)
169	    (hr : ∀ c ∈ List.range s.C.length, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none)
170	    (hp : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, OptP (s.parC f) (fun g => g ∈ s.frames ∧ g < f) True) : FramesC s := by
171	  have hlt : ∀ c, s.Live c → c < s.C.length := fun c hc => by
172	    unfold SC.Live at hc; unfold OptP at hc; split at hc
173	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
174	    · exact hc.elim
175	  refine ⟨h0, fun c hc => hne c (List.mem_range.2 (hlt c hc)) hc, hnd, hb,
176	    fun c h0 hc => hr c (List.mem_range.2 (hlt c hc)) h0 hc, fun f hf g hg => ?_⟩

188	  have hk := (Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.KInvB.sound (s := f2.flat) (by decide)).1

191	    ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, fun _ => i4_always _⟩, by decide, hnd⟩, by decide, hno⟩

193	/-! ## Two entries sharing a controller (report, WC2 C12 and C13) -/
194	
195	/-- Statics: the mutex value `m = {data, lock}` and two protected roots `T₁`, `T₂` both owned by
196	`data`. -/
197	def mst2 : Statics :=
198	  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
199	   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]
200	
201	/-- Initial state: root authorities 1 (of `T₁`) and 2 (of `T₂`) are both held by `data`. -/
202	def d0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst2)
203	
204	/-- WC2 C12 requires distinct controller associations for different mutex instances; the
205	preconditions formalized from WC2 C13 accept `newMutex(1)` then `newMutex(2)`, and both entries

151	/-- The head of a strictly decreasing list bounds its elements (Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/
152	theorem le_head_of_pairwise {h : Nat} {l : List Nat} (hd : (h :: l).Pairwise (· > ·)) :
153	    ∀ b ∈ h :: l, b ≤ h := by
154	  intro b hb
155	  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with rfl | hb
156	  · exact Nat.le_refl _
157	  · exact Nat.le_of_lt ((List.pairwise_cons.1 hd).1 b hb)

159	/-- A duplicate-free stack whose `parIn` links decrease is strictly decreasing (WC2 C3; Spec 1
160	§49, last paragraph). -/
161	theorem pairwise_of_parIn : ∀ {F : List Nat}, F.Nodup →
162	    (∀ f g, parIn none f F = some g → g < f) → F.Pairwise (· > ·)
163	  | [], _, _ => List.Pairwise.nil
164	  | a :: F, hnd, h => by
165	    obtain ⟨hna, hndF⟩ := List.nodup_cons.1 hnd
166	    have ih : F.Pairwise (· > ·) := pairwise_of_parIn hndF fun f g hg => by
167	      by_cases hf : f ∈ F
168	      · have hne : a ≠ f := fun e => hna (by rw [e]; exact hf)
169	        exact h f g (by rw [parIn_cons_ne hne]; exact hg)
170	      · rw [parIn_not_mem hf] at hg; cases hg
171	    refine List.pairwise_cons.2 ⟨?_, ih⟩
172	    cases F with
173	    | nil => intro b hb; cases hb
174	    | cons b' F' =>
175	      have hb' : b' < a := h a b' (by simp [parIn])
176	      intro b hb
177	      exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (le_head_of_pairwise ih b hb) hb'

179	/-- The frame structure of a single-context state makes its stack strictly decreasing (WC2 C3;
180	Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/
181	theorem single_decreasing (hs : s.Single) (hfr : FramesC s) : (s.stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·) := by
182	  refine pairwise_of_parIn (SC.stk_nodup hfr.nodup 0) fun f g hg => ?_
183	  by_cases hf : f ∈ s.stk 0
184	  · exact (hfr.parent f (by rw [single_frames hs]; exact hf) g
185	      (by rw [single_parC hs]; exact hg)).2
186	  · rw [parIn_not_mem hf] at hg; cases hg

267	projection when its `ok` outcomes keep the stack (WC2 C2, C24). -/
268	theorem viewStep_single {R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop} (hs : s.Single)
269	    (hF : ∀ t', R s.toS3 (.ok t') → t'.F = s.toS3.F) :
270	    (∀ o, ViewStep R 0 s o → R s.toS3 (omap SC.toS3 o)) ∧
271	    (∀ o₃, R s.toS3 o₃ → ∃ o, ViewStep R 0 s o ∧ omap SC.toS3 o = o₃) := by
272	  have hv := single_view hs
273	  have back : ∀ o₃, R s.toS3 o₃ → omap SC.toS3 (omap s.set o₃) = o₃ := by
274	    intro o₃ hR
275	    cases o₃ with
276	    | ok t => exact congrArg Outcome3.ok (toS3_set (hF t hR))
277	    | reject => rfl
278	    | fail => rfl
279	  refine ⟨fun o ⟨_, o₃, hR, ho⟩ => ?_, fun o₃ hR => ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, o₃, hv ▸ hR, rfl⟩,
280	    back o₃ hR⟩⟩
281	  rw [hv] at hR; rw [ho, back o₃ hR]; exact hR

283	/-- A guarded operation of the single context has the outcomes of Spec 1 on the projection when
284	its precondition is equivalent and its effect projects to the Spec 1 effect (WC2 C24). -/
285	theorem guarded_single {Pre Pre₃ : Prop} {e : SC} {e₃ : S3} (hs : s.Single) (hp : Pre ↔ Pre₃)
286	    (he : e.toS3 = e₃) :
287	    (∀ o, s.Live 0 ∧ Guarded Pre e o → Guarded Pre₃ e₃ (omap SC.toS3 o)) ∧
288	    (∀ o₃, Guarded Pre₃ e₃ o₃ → ∃ o, (s.Live 0 ∧ Guarded Pre e o) ∧ omap SC.toS3 o = o₃) := by
289	  refine ⟨fun o ⟨_, h⟩ => ?_, fun o₃ h => ?_⟩
290	  · cases h with
291	    | ok hpre => rw [omap, he]; exact .ok (hp.1 hpre)
292	    | reject hn => exact .reject fun h => hn (hp.2 h)
293	  · cases h with
294	    | ok hpre => exact ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, .ok (hp.2 hpre)⟩, by rw [omap, he]⟩
295	    | reject hn => exact ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, .reject fun h => hn (hp.1 h)⟩, rfl⟩

302	    t'.F = t.F := by

304	  | transfer => exact absurd rfl (hnot _ _)
305	  | depend => exact absurd rfl (hnd _ _)
306	  | store => exact absurd rfl (hns _ _)
307	  | enter => exact absurd rfl (hne _ _)

310	  | split => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
311	  | release a =>
312	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
313	  | read => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
314	  | write => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
315	  | writeShared => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
316	  | pin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
317	  | unpin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
318	  | endUse => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
319	  | free => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
320	  | alloc => cases hop; rfl

import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.Sync

/-!
# Preservation of the re-indexed kernel invariant (WC2 C20, C23)

Theorem 2 of the exploratory pass, except `exitFrameC` and `terminate`: the kernel invariant of
Spec 1 §57 re-indexed (`KInvC`), with the auxiliaries of Spec 1 `reachable_inv` (`KAux`,
`HeldAnchored`) read on the flat state, is preserved by the inherited operations O1–O16 other than
O7 executed by a context (Spec 1 §60–§72, §74, §75; WC2 C2), by `spawn` (WC2 C4), `join` (WC2 C8)
and `deriveSync` (WC2 C15).

The clauses of Spec 1 that read the stack only through membership are obtained from the Spec 1
lemmas on the view of the executing context; the anchor orders are proved on `ancestorC`.
Helper lemmas live in `Ern.Concurrency.PreservationAux`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The inductive invariant of theorem 2 (WC2 C20, C23): `KInvC` (Spec 1 §57 re-indexed) with the
auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 `reachable_inv`, read on the flat state. -/
def KInvCA (s : SC) : Prop := KInvC s ∧ KAux s.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s.flat

namespace PreservationAux

/-! ## Membership transport (WC2 C2) -/

/-- `HeldAnchored` reads the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §44, §40). -/
theorem heldAnchored_mem_congr {t : S3} {F' : Frames} (h : HeldAnchored t)
    (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) : HeldAnchored { t with F := F' } :=
  fun x y q hy ya ho hh hq => h x y q hy ya ho hh ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)

/-- The kernel facts of Spec 1 on the view of a context, from the re-indexed invariant (WC2
C2). -/
      have hxq' : x ∈ (transferEffC s c src dst).D q := by
        change x ∈ (if partOf (s.view c).P q src then [] else
          (s.view c).D q ++ movedTo (s.view c) src dst q)
        simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq
      exact hpre.anchorOrder q hq x hxq'

end PreservationAux

open PreservationAux

/-! ## Theorem 2 (except `exitFrameC` and `terminate`) -/

/-- Theorem 2 (WC2 C20, C23; Spec 1 §57 re-indexed): every inherited operation O1–O16 other than
O7, executed by a context with an `ok` outcome, preserves `KInvC` with the auxiliaries `KAux` and
`HeldAnchored` on the flat state, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80, used by `split`). Fragment: the
concurrent kernel without synchronization; O7 (`exitFrameC`) is not covered here. -/
theorem opStepC_preservesC {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp}
    (hk : KInvCA s) (hnx : op ≠ .exit) (h : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) : KInvCA s' := by
  cases op with
  | exit => exact absurd rfl hnx
  | transfer src dst =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact transfer_preserves hk hpre
  | depend q x =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact depend_preserves hk hpre
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact store_preserves hk hpre
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact push_preserves hk hpre.params hpre.localsOK (enter_push hk.1.1.1 hpre.callerLive)
      hpre.anchorOrderHeld
  | derive | split | release | read | write | writeShared | pin | unpin | endUse | free | alloc =>
    obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
    cases o₃ with
    | ok t =>
      cases ho
      exact viewOp_preserves hdd hk hR (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
    | reject => cases ho
    | fail => cases ho

/-- Theorem 2 (WC2 C4, C20, C23): `spawn` (with the preconditions `SpawnPreBase`) preserves `KInvC`
with the auxiliaries on the flat state: the new context has the fresh frame `nF`, child of the
creating frame; the kernel effect is that of Spec 1 §72. -/
theorem spawn_preservesC {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hk : KInvCA s) (h : SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s')) : KInvCA s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact push_preserves hk hpre.params hpre.localsOK (spawn_push hk.1.1.1 hpre.creatorLive)
    hpre.anchorOrderHeld

/-- Theorem 2 (WC2 C8, C20): `join` leaves the state unchanged, hence preserves the invariant. -/
theorem join_preservesC {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} (hk : KInvCA s) (h : JoinStep s c d (.ok s')) :
    KInvCA s' := by
  cases h; exact hk

/-- Theorem 2 (WC2 C15, C20, C23) for `deriveSync`, when `guarded` has own mode `Modify` (WC2
C12, C21.1; WC2 C15 "mode restrictions"). The unrestricted statement is false:
`deriveSync_breaks_i2`. -/
theorem deriveSync_preservesC {kc : KC} {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat} (hk : KInvCA s)
    (hmode : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify) False)
    (h : DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s')) : KInvCA s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact deriveSync_preserves hk hpre hmode

/-- WC2 C15 replaces the conjunct `ExercisableAt(source, Modify)` of Spec 1 §60.1, which bounds
the requested mode by the own mode of the source, by `SyncAuthorized`; §60.2 bounds it only leaf
by leaf. With an opaque `SyncAuthorized` that holds, `deriveSync` from an active `Observe`
authority with an empty footprint (authority 3, derived by frame 0 from the root of static 0)
creates a `Modify` derivative and breaks `I2` (Spec 1 §51: "does not elevate its mode"), from a
state satisfying the invariant. -/
theorem deriveSync_breaks_i2 :
    ∃ (kc : KC) (s s' : SC), KInvCA s ∧ DeriveSyncStep kc s 0 3 (.ok s') ∧ ¬ I2 s'.flat := by
  let t := deriveEff Examples.s0 0 [] .observe
  let s := SC.ofS3 t
  let kc : KC := { Examples.K0 with SyncAuthorized := fun _ _ _ => True }
  have hreach : Reachable Examples.K0 Examples.st t :=
    .step .init (KStep.derive (src := 0) (region := []) (m := .observe) (.ok (by decide)))
  obtain ⟨hkt, hat, hht⟩ := reachable_inv (fun _ _ h => (h : False).elim) (by decide) hreach
  have hs : s.Single := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hts : s.toS3 = t := rfl
  have hfr : FramesC s :=
    { initial := by simp [s, SC.ofS3, OptP]
      nonempty := by
        intro c hc
        unfold SC.Live at hc
        cases c with
        | zero => simp [s, SC.stk, SC.ofS3, t, deriveEff, S3.addAuth, Examples.s0, S3.init]
        | succ c => simp [s, SC.ofS3, OptP] at hc
      nodup := by decide
      bound := by decide
      rooted := by
        intro c hc hl
        unfold SC.Live at hl
        cases c with
        | zero => exact absurd rfl hc
        | succ c => simp [s, SC.ofS3, OptP] at hl
      parent := by decide }
  have hflat : s.flat = t := by rw [single_flat hs, hts]
  refine ⟨kc, s, deriveSyncEff s 0 3, ⟨(single_kInvC hs).2 ⟨hfr, hts ▸ hkt⟩,
    by rw [hflat]; exact hat, by rw [hflat]; exact hht⟩,
    ⟨by decide, .ok ⟨by decide, trivial, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
      by decide⟩⟩, fun h2 => ?_⟩
  have e4 : (deriveSyncEff s 0 3).flat.A[4]? =
      some ⟨.modify, some 3, [], .frame 0, true⟩ := by decide
  have e3 : (deriveSyncEff s 0 3).flat.A[3]? =
      some ⟨.observe, some 0, [], .frame 0, true⟩ := by decide
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hm, -⟩ := h2 4 _ 3 e4 rfl
  rw [e3] at hx; cases hx
  simp [Mode.le] at hm

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib

/-!
# Preservation of the synchronization invariants (WC2 C21–C23)

Theorem 4 of the brief, preservation half: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5) and
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) are preserved by every labelled step `LStep` taken under the
encapsulation hypothesis `Encap` (WC2 C22, C23), together with two auxiliary invariants that are
not WC2 clauses (`GrantSubtree`, `RegBound`). The kernel facts about the states before and after
a step (`KInvC` before, `ConcurrentWF` after) are hypotheses supplied by theorem 2 (preservation of
the re-indexed kernel invariant).

`newMutex_nonleaf_rejected` shows the role of the leaf clause of `NewMutexPreBase.control` (WC2
C12, C13.3): a positional controller that is not a leaf would break `SyncInv.control`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Auxiliary invariants (not WC2 clauses) -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause (needed by `unlock`, WC2 C17): while the recorded grant
of a live entry is active, every active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf is the
grant or one of its descendants. -/
def GrantSubtree (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause: every registered `guarded` identity exists (an entry
cannot become live by the creation of a fresh authority). -/
def RegBound (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The preserved conjunction: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) with the
auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg ∧ GrantSubtree s reg ∧ RegBound s reg

namespace SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Per-entry decomposition -/

/-- The clauses of `SyncState` about one entry (WC2 C21.1–C21.3, C22, auxiliaries). -/
structure EntryOK (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop where
  guarded : e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  grant : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  control : e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  disc : e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
  sub : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  bound : e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The global clause of `SyncState` (WC2 C21.5). -/
def Uniq (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' → e.Live s →
    e'.Live s → e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
end SyncPreserveAux

open SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Theorem 4, preservation half -/

/-- Theorem 4 (WC2 C21–C23), preservation: every labelled step taken under `Encap` preserves
`SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5),
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) and the auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. The kernel
facts `WF3` before and after the step are parts of `KInvC` and `ConcurrentWF` supplied by theorem
2. Fragment: the concurrent kernel with the reference synchronization library. -/
theorem lstep_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap st lbl)
    (hw : WF3 st.1.flat) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) :
    SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case transfer src dst => exact transfer_preserves h he hw hw' hs
    all_goals
      have hf := opStep_facts (reg := reg) h he (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw
      exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @spawn s s' reg c ps ls h =>
    have hf := spawn_facts (reg := reg) h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @terminate s s' reg c h =>
    have hf := term_facts (reg := reg) hw h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @join s s' reg c d h =>
    have hf := join_facts (reg := reg) h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | deriveSync h => exact (deriveSync_excluded h he).elim
  | newMutex h => exact newMutex_preserves h hw hs
  | acquire h => exact acquire_preserves h hw hw' hs
  | unlock h => exact unlock_preserves h hw hw' hs
  | resetLock h => exact resetLock_preserves h hs

/-- Theorem 4 (WC2 C22, C23), trace form: along an encapsulated trace (`EncapsulatedTrace`),
`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and the auxiliaries are preserved, given a state invariant `Q` that
implies `WF3` and is preserved by every labelled step (theorem 2 provides it: `KInvC` with its
auxiliaries). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') (Q : SC → Prop) (hQw : ∀ s, Q s → WF3 s.flat)
    (hQ : ∀ lbl st₀ st₁, LStep k L lbl st₀ st₁ → Q st₀.1 → Q st₁.1) (hQ0 : Q st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact hs
  | cons he hst _ ih =>
    exact ih (hQ _ _ _ hst hQ0)
      (lstep_preserves hst he (hQw _ hQ0) (hQw _ (hQ _ _ _ hst hQ0)) hs)

/-! ## Role of the leaf clause of `newMutex` -/

namespace SyncPreserveWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples

/-- A mutex value `m` (place 0) whose fields are `data` (place 1, a leaf owning the root `T`,
place 4) and `lock` (place 2, a structure with one leaf, place 3), owned by frame 0 (Spec 1
§47). Authority 1 is the root authority of `T`, held by `data`. -/
def nmStatics : Statics := [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
  ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 2, none, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- The single-context state of `nmStatics`. -/
def nm0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init nmStatics)

/-- Field 0 holds `guarded`, field 1 is the controller (WC2 C12). -/
def nmL : MutexLayout := ⟨0, 1⟩

/-- Frame structure of `nm0` (WC2 C3). -/
theorem nm0_framesC : FramesC nm0 where
  initial := by decide
  nonempty := fun c hc => by
    cases c with
    | zero => decide
    | succ c => exact hc.elim
  nodup := by decide
  bound := by decide
  rooted := fun c hc hl => by
    cases c with
    | zero => exact absurd rfl hc
    | succ c => exact hl.elim
  parent := fun f hf g hg => by
    have hf0 : f = 0 := by simpa [nm0, SC.frames, SC.stk, SC.ofS3, S3.init] using hf
    subst hf0
    have : nm0.parC 0 = none := by decide
    rw [this] at hg; cases hg

/-- Kernel invariant of `nm0` (Spec 1 §57 via WC2 C24). -/
theorem nm0_kInvC : KInvC nm0 :=
  (single_kInvC ⟨_, rfl⟩).2 ⟨nm0_framesC, (init_kinv (by decide)).1⟩

end SyncPreserveWitness

open SyncPreserveWitness Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples in
/-- Role of the leaf clause of `NewMutexPreBase.control` (WC2 C12, C13.3): in `nm0` the positional
controller of `guarded = 1` is place 2, which is not a leaf; `newMutex(1)` is rejected by that
clause, and registering the entry would break `SyncInv.control`. -/
theorem newMutex_nonleaf_rejected :
    KInvC nm0 ∧ ControlOf nmL nm0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ¬ isLeaf nm0.P 2 ∧
    ¬ NewMutexPreBase nmL [] nm0 [] 0 1 ∧ ¬ SyncInv nmL nm0 [⟨1, none⟩] := by
  refine ⟨nm0_kInvC, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h.control ⟨1, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide); revert this; decide

end Ern.Concurrency

101	theorem encapsulated_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
102	    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
103	    (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st') :
104	    KInvC st'.1 ∧ SyncInv L st'.1 st'.2 ∧ GrantDiscipline st'.1 st'.2 := by
105	  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hst L
106	  obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := trace_inv hdd h hk hs
107	  exact ⟨hk'.1, hs'.1, hs'.2.1⟩

import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib

/-!
# Preservation of the synchronization invariants (WC2 C21–C23)

Theorem 4 of the brief, preservation half: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5) and
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) are preserved by every labelled step `LStep` taken under the
encapsulation hypothesis `Encap` (WC2 C22, C23), together with two auxiliary invariants that are
not WC2 clauses (`GrantSubtree`, `RegBound`). The kernel facts about the states before and after
a step (`KInvC` before, `ConcurrentWF` after) are hypotheses supplied by theorem 2 (preservation of
the re-indexed kernel invariant).

`newMutex_nonleaf_rejected` shows the role of the leaf clause of `NewMutexPreBase.control` (WC2
C12, C13.3): a positional controller that is not a leaf would break `SyncInv.control`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Auxiliary invariants (not WC2 clauses) -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause (needed by `unlock`, WC2 C17): while the recorded grant
of a live entry is active, every active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf is the
grant or one of its descendants. -/
def GrantSubtree (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause: every registered `guarded` identity exists (an entry
cannot become live by the creation of a fresh authority). -/
def RegBound (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The preserved conjunction: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) with the
auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg ∧ GrantSubtree s reg ∧ RegBound s reg

namespace SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Per-entry decomposition -/

/-- The clauses of `SyncState` about one entry (WC2 C21.1–C21.3, C22, auxiliaries). -/
structure EntryOK (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop where
  guarded : e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  grant : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  control : e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  disc : e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
  sub : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  bound : e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The global clause of `SyncState` (WC2 C21.5). -/
def Uniq (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' → e.Live s →
    e'.Live s → e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
end SyncPreserveAux

open SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Theorem 4, preservation half -/

/-- Theorem 4 (WC2 C21–C23), preservation: every labelled step taken under `Encap` preserves
`SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5),
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) and the auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. The kernel
facts `WF3` before and after the step are parts of `KInvC` and `ConcurrentWF` supplied by theorem
2. Fragment: the concurrent kernel with the reference synchronization library. -/
theorem lstep_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap st lbl)
    (hw : WF3 st.1.flat) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) :
    SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case transfer src dst => exact transfer_preserves h he hw hw' hs
    all_goals
      have hf := opStep_facts (reg := reg) h he (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw
      exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @spawn s s' reg c ps ls h =>
    have hf := spawn_facts (reg := reg) h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @terminate s s' reg c h =>
    have hf := term_facts (reg := reg) hw h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @join s s' reg c d h =>
    have hf := join_facts (reg := reg) h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | deriveSync h => exact (deriveSync_excluded h he).elim
  | newMutex h => exact newMutex_preserves h hw hs
  | acquire h => exact acquire_preserves h hw hw' hs
  | unlock h => exact unlock_preserves h hw hw' hs
  | resetLock h => exact resetLock_preserves h hs

/-- Theorem 4 (WC2 C22, C23), trace form: along an encapsulated trace (`EncapsulatedTrace`),
`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and the auxiliaries are preserved, given a state invariant `Q` that
implies `WF3` and is preserved by every labelled step (theorem 2 provides it: `KInvC` with its
auxiliaries). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') (Q : SC → Prop) (hQw : ∀ s, Q s → WF3 s.flat)
    (hQ : ∀ lbl st₀ st₁, LStep k L lbl st₀ st₁ → Q st₀.1 → Q st₁.1) (hQ0 : Q st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact hs
  | cons he hst _ ih =>
    exact ih (hQ _ _ _ hst hQ0)
      (lstep_preserves hst he (hQw _ hQ0) (hQw _ (hQ _ _ _ hst hQ0)) hs)

/-! ## Role of the leaf clause of `newMutex` -/

namespace SyncPreserveWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples

/-- A mutex value `m` (place 0) whose fields are `data` (place 1, a leaf owning the root `T`,
place 4) and `lock` (place 2, a structure with one leaf, place 3), owned by frame 0 (Spec 1
§47). Authority 1 is the root authority of `T`, held by `data`. -/
def nmStatics : Statics := [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
  ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 2, none, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- The single-context state of `nmStatics`. -/
def nm0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init nmStatics)

/-- Field 0 holds `guarded`, field 1 is the controller (WC2 C12). -/
def nmL : MutexLayout := ⟨0, 1⟩

/-- Frame structure of `nm0` (WC2 C3). -/
theorem nm0_framesC : FramesC nm0 where
  initial := by decide
  nonempty := fun c hc => by
    cases c with
    | zero => decide
    | succ c => exact hc.elim
  nodup := by decide
  bound := by decide
  rooted := fun c hc hl => by
    cases c with
    | zero => exact absurd rfl hc
    | succ c => exact hl.elim
  parent := fun f hf g hg => by
    have hf0 : f = 0 := by simpa [nm0, SC.frames, SC.stk, SC.ofS3, S3.init] using hf
    subst hf0
    have : nm0.parC 0 = none := by decide
    rw [this] at hg; cases hg

/-- Kernel invariant of `nm0` (Spec 1 §57 via WC2 C24). -/
theorem nm0_kInvC : KInvC nm0 :=
  (single_kInvC ⟨_, rfl⟩).2 ⟨nm0_framesC, (init_kinv (by decide)).1⟩

end SyncPreserveWitness

open SyncPreserveWitness Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples in
/-- Role of the leaf clause of `NewMutexPreBase.control` (WC2 C12, C13.3): in `nm0` the positional
controller of `guarded = 1` is place 2, which is not a leaf; `newMutex(1)` is rejected by that
clause, and registering the entry would break `SyncInv.control`. -/
theorem newMutex_nonleaf_rejected :
    KInvC nm0 ∧ ControlOf nmL nm0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ¬ isLeaf nm0.P 2 ∧
    ¬ NewMutexPreBase nmL [] nm0 [] 0 1 ∧ ¬ SyncInv nmL nm0 [⟨1, none⟩] := by
  refine ⟨nm0_kInvC, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h.control ⟨1, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide); revert this; decide

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity

/-!
# Reparenting at frame exit and context termination (WC2 C6, C7; OB-C13)

`exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73 re-indexed with the reparenting of WC2 C6.3) and `terminate` (WC2 C7):

* the frame structure after the step (`FramesC`), and the extended ancestry of the surviving
  frames, which is the ancestry before the step with the exiting frame skipped
  (`exitEffC_ancestorC`, `termEffC_ancestorC`);
* Theorem 3 (OB-C13): both steps preserve `AnchorOrderC` and `AnchorOrderHeldC`, and change `A`
  and `D` exactly as the effect of Spec 1 §73 (`exitEffC_kernel`, `termEffC_kernel`); reparenting
  targets the immediate surviving parent (`exitEffC_reparent`, `termEffC_reparent`);
* Theorem 2 restricted to these steps: `KInvC` and the auxiliaries `RootHeldConv`,
  `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 on the globally live frames are preserved (`exitFrameC_preserves`,
  `terminate_preserves`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

open ReparentAux

/-! ## `exitFrameC` and `terminate` pop a frame (WC2 C6, C7) -/

section Steps

variable {s : SC} {c : Nat}

/-- Unfolding of the context list after `exitFrameC` (WC2 C6). -/
theorem exitEffC_C_get (d : Nat) : (exitEffC s c).C[d]? = (s.C[d]?).map fun x =>
    let x' := if c = d then { x with stack := x.stack.tail } else x
    if x'.life = .live ∧ x'.parent = some ((s.stk c).headD 0) then
  · have e := ReparentAux.parC_of_mem hnd hfc
    rw [hc] at e ⊢
    simp only [parIn, ↓reduceIte, List.head?_nil, Option.none_or] at e
    show s.parC f = some ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0)
    rw [e, hp]; rfl

/-- After `terminate`, the terminated context is not live (WC2 C7). -/
theorem termEffC_not_live : ¬ (termEffC s c).Live c := by
  unfold SC.Live; rw [termEffC_C_get]
  cases hx : s.C[c]? with
  | none => simp [OptP]
  | some x => simp only [Option.map_some, OptP, ↓reduceIte]; split <;> simp

/-- WC2 C3, C6.5, C20: `exitFrameC` keeps a well-founded frame structure. -/
theorem exitEffC_framesC (hfr : FramesC s) (hcall : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []) :
    FramesC (exitEffC s c) := by
  have h := exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hcall
  refine h.framesC hfr ?_ fun d hl => ?_
  · have h0 := hfr.initial
    rw [exitEffC_C_get]
    cases hx : s.C[0]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at h0; exact h0.elim
    | some x =>
      rw [hx] at h0; simp only [OptP] at h0
      simp only [Option.map_some, OptP]
      by_cases hc0 : c = 0 <;> simp_all
  · rw [h.stk d]; split
    · exact hcall
    · exact hfr.nonempty d (h.live d hl)

/-- WC2 C3, C6.5, C7, C20: `terminate` keeps a well-founded frame structure. -/
theorem termEffC_framesC (hfr : FramesC s) (hc0 : c ≠ 0) (hone : (s.stk c).length = 1)
    (hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none) : FramesC (termEffC s c) := by
  have h := termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar
  refine h.framesC hfr ?_ fun d hl => ?_
  · have h0 := hfr.initial
    rw [termEffC_C_get]
    cases hx : s.C[0]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at h0; exact h0.elim
    | some x =>
      rw [hx] at h0; simp only [OptP] at h0
      simp only [Option.map_some, OptP]
      simp_all
  · rw [h.stk d]; split
    · rename_i hdc; subst hdc; exact absurd hl termEffC_not_live
    · exact hfr.nonempty d (h.live d hl)

/-- WC2 C6.3, C6.4 (OB-C13): after `exitFrameC`, the live frames are those before except the
exiting frame, and the extended ancestry between live frames is unchanged: reparenting only
removes the exiting frame from the chains. -/
theorem exitEffC_ancestorC (hfr : FramesC s) (hcall : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []) {g y : Nat} :
    (y ∈ (exitEffC s c).frames ↔ y ∈ s.frames ∧ y ≠ (s.stk c).headD 0) ∧
    (g ∈ (exitEffC s c).frames → y ∈ (exitEffC s c).frames →
      ((exitEffC s c).ancestorC g y ↔ s.ancestorC g y)) :=
  ⟨(exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hcall).mem_frames hfr.nodup,
   (exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hcall).ancestorC hfr⟩

/-- WC2 C6.3, C6.4, C7 (OB-C13): after `terminate`, the live frames are those before except the
initial frame of the terminated context, and the extended ancestry between live frames is
unchanged. -/
theorem termEffC_ancestorC (hfr : FramesC s) (hone : (s.stk c).length = 1)
    (hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none) {g y : Nat} :
    (y ∈ (termEffC s c).frames ↔ y ∈ s.frames ∧ y ≠ (s.stk c).headD 0) ∧
    (g ∈ (termEffC s c).frames → y ∈ (termEffC s c).frames →
      ((termEffC s c).ancestorC g y ↔ s.ancestorC g y)) :=
  ⟨(termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).mem_frames hfr.nodup,
   (termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).ancestorC hfr⟩

/-- WC2 C6.3 (OB-C13): `exitFrameC` reparents exactly the live contexts whose initial frame had
the exiting frame as parent, to the immediate surviving parent of the exiting frame (its caller),
and changes no other parent. -/
theorem exitEffC_reparent (hfr : FramesC s) (hcall : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []) :
    s.parC ((s.stk c).headD 0) = some ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) ∧
    ∀ d, (exitEffC s c).Live d → (exitEffC s c).ctxParent d =
      if s.ctxParent d = some ((s.stk c).headD 0) then some ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0)
      else s.ctxParent d :=
  ⟨(exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hcall).pf, (exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hcall).par⟩

/-- WC2 C6.3, C7 (OB-C13): `terminate` reparents exactly the live contexts whose initial frame
had the terminated initial frame as parent, to the immediate parent of that frame. -/
theorem termEffC_reparent (hfr : FramesC s) (hone : (s.stk c).length = 1)
    (hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none) :
    s.parC ((s.stk c).headD 0) = some ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) ∧
    ∀ d, (termEffC s c).Live d → (termEffC s c).ctxParent d =
      if s.ctxParent d = some ((s.stk c).headD 0) then some ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0)
      else s.ctxParent d :=
  ⟨(termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).pf, (termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).par⟩

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC2 C6, C6.6; Spec 1 §73 effect): `exitFrameC` changes the kernel
components exactly as the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`; reparenting changes only the
contexts, so it creates, elevates, revives and reanchors nothing. -/
theorem exitEffC_kernel (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
    (exitEffC s c).A = (exitEff (s.view c)).A ∧ (exitEffC s c).D = (exitEff (s.view c)).D ∧
    (exitEffC s c).P = s.P ∧ (exitEffC s c).I = s.I ∧ (exitEffC s c).dead = s.dead ∧
    (exitEffC s c).pins = s.pins ∧ (exitEffC s c).nF = s.nF :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC2 C6, C7; Spec 1 §73 effect): `terminate` changes the kernel components
exactly as the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`. -/
theorem termEffC_kernel (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
    (termEffC s c).A = (exitEff (s.view c)).A ∧ (termEffC s c).D = (exitEff (s.view c)).D ∧
    (termEffC s c).P = s.P ∧ (termEffC s c).I = s.I ∧ (termEffC s c).dead = s.dead ∧
    (termEffC s c).pins = s.pins ∧ (termEffC s c).nF = s.nF :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

end Steps

/-! ## Theorems 2 and 3 for `exitFrameC` and `terminate` -/

section Main

variable {k : K} {s s' : SC} {c : Nat}

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC2 C6; Spec 1 §44, §73): an `ok` `exitFrameC` preserves `AnchorOrderC`
(not a precondition of O7) and establishes `AnchorOrderHeldC` (§73.5), with the reparented
initial frames. Fragment: states with the frame structure `FramesC`, `WF3` and `AnchorOrderC`
on the live frames. -/
theorem exitFrameC_anchorOrder (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hao : AnchorOrderC s)
    (h : opStepC k .exit c s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderC s' ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  exact ⟨(exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.hasCaller).anchorOrderC hfr hw hao rfl hpre.anchors
    hpre.origins, hpre.anchorOrderHeld⟩

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC2 C6, C7; Spec 1 §44, §73): an `ok` `terminate` preserves
`AnchorOrderC` and establishes `AnchorOrderHeldC`, with the reparented initial frames.
Fragment: as `exitFrameC_anchorOrder`. -/
theorem terminate_anchorOrder (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hao : AnchorOrderC s)
    (h : TermStep k s c (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderC s' ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  have hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none := fun e => by
    have := hpre.hasParent; rw [e] at this; exact this
  exact ⟨(termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.initialOnly hpar).anchorOrderC hfr hw hao rfl
    hpre.anchors hpre.origins, hpre.anchorOrderHeld⟩

/-- Theorem 2 for `exitFrameC` (WC2 C6, C20, C23; Spec 1 §57, §73): an `ok` `exitFrameC`
preserves `KInvC` and the auxiliaries `RootHeldConv` and `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 (not clauses
of §57) on the live frames. Fragment: O7 re-indexed. -/
theorem exitFrameC_preserves (hk : KInvC s) (haux : RootHeldConv s.flat)
    (hh : HeldAnchored s.flat) (h : opStepC k .exit c s (.ok s')) :
    KInvC s' ∧ RootHeldConv s'.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s'.flat := by
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  have hfr := hk.1.1
  have hp := exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.hasCaller
  exact ⟨hp.kInvC hk (exitEffC_framesC hfr hpre.hasCaller) rfl hpre.anchors hpre.origins
    hpre.anchorOrderHeld, hp.aux hfr haux hh rfl hpre.origins⟩

/-- Theorem 2 for `terminate` (WC2 C7, C20, C23; Spec 1 §57, §73): an `ok` `terminate`
preserves `KInvC` and the auxiliaries `RootHeldConv` and `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 on the live
frames. -/
theorem terminate_preserves (hk : KInvC s) (haux : RootHeldConv s.flat)
    (hh : HeldAnchored s.flat) (h : TermStep k s c (.ok s')) :
    KInvC s' ∧ RootHeldConv s'.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s'.flat := by
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  have hfr := hk.1.1
  have hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none := fun e => by
    have := hpre.hasParent; rw [e] at this; exact this
  have hp := termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.initialOnly hpar
  exact ⟨hp.kInvC hk (termEffC_framesC hfr hpre.nonInitial hpre.initialOnly hpar) rfl
    hpre.anchors hpre.origins hpre.anchorOrderHeld, hp.aux hfr haux hh rfl hpre.origins⟩

end Main

end Ern.Concurrency

  rw [chainLen_some h]

  have := iter_bound hacyc hlt hy (iter_of_chainLen_ne (k := m) (fun e => hne e.symm))

/-! ## O17 `newArena` (§76) and the guard of §56 -/

/-- All leaves of the place holding an authority are `Init` (§76.5); vacuous for a frame. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

/-- Decidability of `LeavesInit` (§76.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- The unified administration guard (§56, §76.4) as a contract predicate: `internal` is absent
from every registry of live administrations. A registry is given by the `internal` identities of
its live administrations; `regs` lists all relevant registries. -/
def Guard56 (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Prop := ∀ R ∈ regs, i ∉ R

/-- Decidability of `Guard56` (§56). -/
instance (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 regs i) := by
  unfold Guard56; infer_instance

/-- The arena registry as a registry of live administrations (§46, §56): the `internal`
identities of its live entries. -/
def liveInternals (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) : List Nat :=
  (arenas.filter fun E => decide (s.Active E.internal)).map (·.internal)

    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
    ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩⟩

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6 (read on the resulting state, v0.1 §76.6). -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)

/-! ## O18 `issue` (§77) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `issue(arena, region, destination)` (§77.1, §77.2). The static
restrictions of §77.3 are given no list by the text and are not represented. -/
structure IssueStatic (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.1: the entry is live; `internal` is active. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §77.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E

import Lean
import Ern
open Lean Meta Elab Command

def isTarget (n : Name) : Bool :=
  n == `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename.perm_range_of_nodup ||
  n == `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename.shapeP_down ||
  (n.toString.endsWith "chainLen_step" && n.toString.startsWith "_private.Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Statics")

elab "#audit" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let mut others : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, ci) in env.constants.toList do
    if let .thmInfo _ := ci then
      let modn : Name := match (env.getModuleIdxFor? n) with | some i => env.header.moduleNames[i.toNat]! | none => Name.anonymous
      if (`Ern).isPrefixOf modn && !(`Ern.Concurrency).isPrefixOf modn then
        let ax ← liftCoreM (Lean.collectAxioms n)
        if ax.contains `Classical.choice then others := others.push n
  let s := others.qsort (fun a b => a.toString < b.toString)
  -- group by pattern
  let mut groups : Std.HashMap String Nat := {}
  for n in s do
    let str := n.toString
    let key :=
      if (`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename).isPrefixOf n then "Access.Rename.*"
      else if (`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.StaticsConf.exists_renumber).isPrefixOf n then "exists_renumber*"
      else str
    groups := groups.insert key (groups.getD key 0 + 1)
  logInfo m!"{s.size}: {groups.toList}"
#audit
EOF

862:1. The current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller.
The detailed by-value calling convention remains subject to Spec 3. This provisional composite is included to test cross-context ownership transfer and is not a final calling-convention decision.

## C6. Frame Exit and Reparenting

Concurrent frame exit applies the safety conditions and validity effects of O7 to the global authority state.

For a non-base frame `f` whose surviving parent is `p = parent(f)`:

1. O7's applicable conditions must hold.
2. All surviving active authorities and dependencies must remain valid.
3. Each surviving context-initial frame whose direct parent is `f` is reparented to `p`.
4. The extended ancestry relation is updated accordingly.
5. The resulting frame structure must remain well-founded and preserve all applicable authority and dependency invariants.
6. Reparenting does not create or elevate rights and does not revive dead storage or dead anchors.

The reparenting target is the immediate surviving parent `p`, not an arbitrarily chosen ancestor.

The ordinary effects of frame exit on local places, authorities, and reanchoring remain governed by O7.

A frame cannot exit merely because reparenting would restore structural ancestry. Its surviving resources must independently satisfy the validity requirements.

Fact check of `formal/reports/spec2-m1.md` against the code on `formal/spec2-m1`. Every Lean name cited in (a), (c), (d), (e) exists. All the witnesses and counterexamples establish what the report says. I found five real discrepancies and some minor ones. Nothing was edited and I did not run `lake build`. I checked with scratch Lean files (`#check`, `#print axioms`, `decide`, `collectAxioms`) under the scratchpad.

## Discrepancies

1. **`trace_preserves` is misplaced and misdescribed.**
   - Report (§c, T4, line 94): "`trace_preserves`, `trace_inv` (`Reachable.lean`) : le long d'une `EncapsulatedTrace`, `KInvCA` et `SyncState` sont préservés ensemble".
   - Only `trace_inv` is in `Reachable.lean:67`. It preserves `KInvCA ∧ SyncState` under `DDSound`, `KInvCA st.1` and `SyncState`.
   - `trace_preserves` is in `SyncPreserve.lean:1195`. It preserves only `SyncState`, and it takes an abstract invariant `Q` with `hQw : ∀ s, Q s → WF3 s.flat`, `hQ` and `hQ0`. It does not mention `KInvCA`.

2. **`grants_exclusive` is described as weaker than it is.**
   - Report (§c, T6, line 105): "deux autorités actives distinctes de mode `Modify` … ne coexistent pas".
   - `SyncLib.lean:357-362` requires only `xm : x.mode = .modify`. Nothing constrains `y.mode`. The proof gets both modes `Observe` from I1 and contradicts `xm`.
   - The theorem is stronger than the report states: one Modify grant is enough.

3. **P4 is wrong about `newArena`.**
   - Report (§e, P4, line 154): "`newArena` … ne consulte que le registre des arènes".
   - `Arena.lean:607-612` has `NewArenaPre … (others : List (List Nat))` with `guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal`. `NewArenaStep` takes `others` too ("the other registries of live administrations consulted by the guard (§56)").
   - So `newArena` does consult other registries, through a static parameter. The accurate point is that `others` is a fixed argument and is not read from an evolving sync registry.

4. **"Chacun nommant le lemme recopié" is false for many copies.**
   - Report (§c, T2, line 79): the copied Spec 1 lemmas each name the lemma they copy.
   - Only the `enter_*` and `free`/`endUse` copies, `transfer_rootHeld`, `transfer_rootHeldConv` and `transfer_anchorOrderHeld` name their original. The `Alloc.*` and `Frames.enter_anchorOrder` ones are labelled "mirrors", not copies.
   - About 15 copied helpers in `Preservation.lean` say only "copy of a private helper": lines 659, 666, 687, 696, 707, 809, 818, 823, 832, 840, 1092, 1554, 1562, 1571, 1578. These are `skel_of_A`, `wf3_skel`, `inv3base_skel`, `noDangling_skel`, `rootHeldConv_of`, `storeEff_eq`, `store_get`, `store_root`, `store_D`, `getElem?_append_cases`, `optP_false_iff'`, `mem_movedTo'`, `mem_movedDeps_part'`, `not_partOf_src'` and one more store-holder lemma (line 823).
   - Their declaration names equal the originals in `Preserve/Small.lean` and `Preserve/Transfer.lean` (primed for Transfer). The docstrings do not name the original or its file.

5. **The `Base` suffix claim is too broad.**
   - Report (§d intro, line 113): "D1 à D6 et D8 … Les définitions concernées portent le suffixe `Base`".
   - Only three definitions carry it: `SpawnPreBase`, `SpawnValPreBase`, `NewMutexPreBase`.
   - Not `Base`: `JoinStep` (D3), `SyncInv`, `AcquireOk`, `UnlockOk`, `ResetLockOk` (D5, D6), `ExitPreC` and `TermPre` (D8). D4 has no definition.
   - Same sentence: "aucune interprétation n'a été choisie" sits next to D5, which says C21.3 and C21.5 are "formalisés en lecture minimale explicite". The report contradicts itself here.

## Minor and unreproduced

- **Unreproduced counts, (b) line 54 and line 51.** I counted 641 theorem constants in modules under `Ern.Concurrency`, where the report says 635. I counted 3593 theorems in non-Concurrency `Ern` modules, where it says 3598. Lazily realised `eq_N` lemmas could explain a gap this small. The axiom claims behind both counts hold (see below).
- **(f) line 159.** "Sur les états à un contexte, `ancestorC` coïncide exactement avec §39 (`single_ancestorC`)" leaves out the hypothesis `(s.stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·)`. §(c) states it correctly. `single_anchorOrderC` and `single_anchorOrderHeldC` need it too.
- **(e) line 139 and `Context.lean:311`.** "Les clauses de §49–§54 seulement par l'appartenance" is loose. `wf3_mem_congr` (`Context.lean:335`) also needs `F'.Nodup` and `F' ≠ []`, as its own docstring says.
- **Cosmetic names.** `Transfer.readings_differ` and `Preservation.deriveSync_breaks_i2` use file names as prefixes. The real names are `Ern.Concurrency.readings_differ` and `Ern.Concurrency.deriveSync_breaks_i2`. Only `Traces.*` is a real namespace.

## Checked and fine

- **Witnesses, all confirmed with the stated shape and hypotheses:**
  - `readings_differ`: `SpawnValPreBase … ∧ SrcRightBefore … ∧ ¬ SrcRightAfterSpawn …`, proved by `decide`. After the spawn part both the source `HasRight` and the §63.4 grounding clause fail.
  - `readingA_final`.
  - `shared_controller`: both `ControlOf` values are place 2.
  - `derive_step` and `acquire_blocked_by_derive`: both `modeOK` (§60.2) and `exclusive` (§60.3) fail in `c1`, and the effective mode of `guarded` on leaf 3 is `Observe`.
  - `realizability_needs_i1`: `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline`, `LibSyncAuthorized` hold, I1 fails and `DeriveSyncPre` fails.
  - `deriveSync_breaks_i2`: it uses `SyncAuthorized := fun _ _ _ => True` and an `Observe` authority with empty footprint.
  - `newMutex_nonleaf_rejected`, `frames_run`, `join_waits`.
  - `conservative_op` and `conservative_deriveSync`, which has no `Single` hypothesis.
  - `realizability`'s hypotheses.
- **Section (a) file assignments** all match.
- **Section (b):**
  - The three `Classical.byContradiction` sites are at `Statics.lean:194` (private `chainLen_step`), `Rename/Basic.lean:146` (`perm_range_of_nodup`) and `Rename/Places.lean:264` (`shapeP_down`).
  - The 34 dependents (31 plus the three) match the report's list exactly.
  - The 442-theorem set and its split reproduce exactly when filtering with `¬ Name.isInternal` (342 / 64 / 36; Main 70, Alloc 54, Common 1, DerivSplitRelease 46, EndFree 71, Frames 112, Small 60, Transfer 28).
  - 136 non-Concurrency theorems depend on `Classical.choice`.
  - The Concurrency axiom union is exactly {propext, Quot.sound}.
  - The `AGENTS.md` grep prints nothing.
  - The core lemmas named in the report do depend on `Classical.choice`, and `KernelOp` has no `DecidableEq`.

Not checked: the build state ("sans avertissement"), the 442 split under any filter other than `isInternal`, and WC2 quotes beyond a grep of the cited phrases (all found, including the C5.8 one).

Risk: item 3 is the only one that changes the meaning of a proposed design decision (P4); the others are labelling or precision issues.
